tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma lha mo bco lnga'i smin byed dbang gi mtshams sbyor 'phrin las rab rgyas zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru buddha dhwa dza ye/ rang sems bla ma yi dam lha/ /dbyer med mkha' 'gro'i dbang mo la/ /btud de de yi smin byed kyi/ /mtshams sbyor 'phrin las rab rgyas spel/ /de la sgrub dkyil kho bo yi/ /logs su bshad ltar nyams blang ste/ /skabs su babs tshe don gnyer gyi/ /slob ma dam tshig bsrung nus pa/ /nyer lnga tshun gyi kha yar ba/ /khrus byas yon phul gral la 'khod/ /las kyi rdo rjes me tog ni/ /bkye bsdu bla mas 'di skad brjod/ ༈ /'o nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi rtsa ba mngon par dbang bskur ba zab mo gsan la thugs nyams su bzhes snyam pa byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa gsal 'debs pa dang / chos gsan pa'i kun tu spyod pa yang mdo rgyud dri ma med pa rnams kyi nang nas ji ltar 'byung ba ltar/ legs par gsal btab nas gsan par zhu/ de la rtsa ba'i rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa'i brtag pa dang po'i le'u dang po las/ lha mo bco lnga'i rang bzhin gyi rtsa sum cu rtsa gnyis gsungs/ gnyis par rnam 'byor ma rnams kyi phreng sngags gsungs/ lnga par rdzogs rim kyi rten las kyi phyag rgya'i tshul gsungs/ drug par rnal 'byor ma rnams dang spyod pa spyad pa'i tshul gsungs/ bdun par rnal 'byor ma rnams dang / 'du ba'i phyag rgya dang / 'du ba'i gnas dang / 'du ba'i dus dang / nang rdo rje'i lus la lha mo rnams bsgom pa'i gnas dang / de dag gi rlung sems dbu mar zhugs pa las/ sa lam bsgrod pa'i tshul rnams gsungs/ brgyad par sbas pa ltar na nye rgyu ston mod kyi/ spyi don ltar na lha mo bco lnga'i rten dang brten par bcas pa'i bskyed rim gsungs/

dgu par de'i rnam gzhag gsungs/ bcu par smin byed kyi dbang gsungs/ brtag pa phyi ma'i gnyis par/ bdag med rnal 'byor ldan pa'am/ yang na he ru ka dpal brtson/ zhes rgyud 'di'i lugs kyi tshe 'di la phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub bsgrub pa'i rten la he ru ka phyag bcu drug pa'am/ bdag med ma gang rung gi rnal 'byor dgos pa tsam zhig bstan/ gsum par yul drug dbang po drug lha mor bsgom tshul gsungs/ bzhi par lha mo bco lnga la phyag rgya gang gis rgyas 'debs pa dang / sa bon gang las bskyed pa dang / rtsa so gnyis lha mo gang yin pa sogs gsungs so/ /de dag gi dgongs pa rnal 'byor dbang phyug gis smin byed kyi dbang dang / grol byed kyi lam gnyis gsungs pa las/ dang po ni/ le'u bcu pa las gsungs pa ltar/ bdag med ma'i dkyil 'khor du dbang gi mngon par rtogs pa bdun gyis dbang bskur bar bzhed cing / yab kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga phal cher 'di dang 'dra zhing / mi 'dra ba'i khyad par rnams phyi ma'i lnga pa las gsungs te/ bco lnga pa yongs su bskor ba yi/ /bdag gi 'khor lo khyod bshad na/ /khyod kyi 'khor lo ji ltar lags/ /zhus pa'i lan du/ bskyed rim gyi khyad par sku mngon byung / sngags kyi khyad par gsung mngon byung / dbang chog gi khyad par thugs mngon byung rnams gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /da lta yab kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga gzhir bzhag nas/ de las yum gyi mi 'dra ba'i khyad par rnams len pa ni/ rje btsun rtse mos yab kyi phyogs la cho ga rgyas par mdzad pa de'i dbang du byas pa'o/ /de ltar yang rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma'i dkyil 'khor chen por dbang bskur bsgrub par byed pa la rgyas pa'i dbang du byas na/ dbang gi mngon par rtogs pa bdun ka tshang bar bya dgos shing / lam 'bras sogs dang ma 'brel ba'i dbang bskur tsam la ni bsdus pas chog pas de la sta gon du gnas pa dang /

dngos gzhir gnas pa gnyis kyi dang po sta gon du gnas pa la/ sa'i lha mo'i sta gon/ lha sta gon/ bum pa sta gon/ slob ma sta gon dang bzhi las/ dang po gsum ni slob dpon kho na'i bya ba'i las yin pas sngon du song zin/ khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa slob ma sta gon du gnas pa la/ lus kyi bya ba nges 'byung bskyed/ nang dbang bskur la khyad don zhu/ spro ba bskyed de rgyun bshags bya/ bsrung ba byas te mchod pas mchod/ so shing dor la khyor chu blud/ /srung skud btags te ku sha sbyin/ /zab mo'i chos bshad rmi lam brtag /ces pa ltar/ don tshan rnam pa bcu bzhir bsdus pa las/ dang po lus kyi bya ba khrus byas gos gsar pa gyon/ snyim pa me tog dang bcas pas gral la 'khod pa tsam gyis don tshang ba yin/ gnyis pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i bsam pa brtan po bskyed du bzhugs pa 'di la gsan pas khyab par gda' ste/ sngags kyi dngos grub don gnyer gang / dkyil 'khor 'dir ni bzhugs par bya/ bsod nams 'dod pas de las gzhan/ /gzhan dag 'jig rten pha rol gnyer/ /dad pa chen po ldan pa dag /blo ldan dkyil 'khor bzhugs bya ste/ /'di yis 'bras bu gnyer mi bya/ /gal te 'di 'bras don gnyer na/ /'jig rten pha rol 'grub mi 'gyur/ /'jig rten pha rol la dmigs na/ /'bad pa med pa 'di 'bras 'grub/ /de'i don ni sngags kyi dngos grub zhes bya ba sems can thams cad kyi don du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub don du gnyer ba'i sgo nas dkyil 'khor chen por zhugs par bya ba yin gyis/ tshe 'di'i nad zhi gdon zhi phyi ma lha mi'i go 'phang dang / rang don du nyan rang gi byang chub don du gnyer ba yin na/ 'di lta bus dkyil 'khor chen por 'jug par bya ba ma yin te/ de dag ni thabs gzhan gyi sgo nas bsgrub tu yod pa yin/ des na dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i dgos pa'i rtsa ba ni 'jig rten pha rol te mya ngan las 'das pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa thob par 'dod pa don du gnyer ba yin na/

dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir 'jug par bya ba yin gyi/ de ltar dkyil 'khor du zhugs nas lam nyams su blangs ba de'i tshe phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par 'gyur zhing / des na tshe 'di'i nad zhi gdon zhi/ skye ba phyi ma lha mi'i go 'phang dang / nyan rang gi byang chub rnam par grol ba yang 'bad med du 'grub par 'gyur ba yin te/ dper na 'bras mkhar ma lo legs na rtsa dang phub ma la sogs pa zhar las 'byung ba dang 'dra bas/ de ltar nges par byas nas bsam pa 'di bzhin du bskyed mdzod/ khams gsum 'khor ba gang du gnas kyang sdug bsngal dang skyon gyi rang bzhin las ma 'das te/ ngan song gsum dang / rigs drug gi sdug bsngal bsam gyi mi khyab pa yod pas de las thar par bya dgos/ de yang rang nyid gcig po thar pas ni mi phan/ gnod pa mtha' dag las bskyabs shing phan tshad med pa btags pa'i drin can gyi pha ma 'di rnams 'dod pa bde ba 'dod kyang / thabs la mi mkhas pa'i dbang gis sdug bsngal gyi rgyu mi dge ba rngam po che la longs spyod/ de'i stobs kyis ngan song du 'grim pa 'di rnams snying re rje/ snying rje snyam du bzhag pas mi phan pas/ 'di rnams sdug bsngal las bsgral nas bde ba la dgod dgos/ de'i nus pa da lta bdag la med/ bdag las lhag pa tshangs pa dang brgya byin/ nyan rang sogs su la yang med/ de dag skyob pa'i nus pa sangs rgyas kho na la mnga' ba yin pas/ des na bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du mngon par dbang bskur ba zab mo gsan la lam nyams su len pa la 'bad rtsol bgyi'o snyam pa'i byang chub kyi sems dung pa zhig bsgom dgos/ de ni mya ngan las 'das pa'i bsam pa brtan po bskyed du bzhugs pa yin gsum pa nang gi dbang bskur ba'am/ slob ma dbang bskur bya ba'i cho ga'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ slob dpon rje btsun bdag med ma'i rang bzhin rnam pa he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa yab yum gyi sku can dngos yin snyam du gus 'dud drag po dung pa zhig byas pas/

slob dpon gyi thugs kha'i am̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus la phog pas tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad bsregs shing sbyangs te/ lus 'od kyi gong bu gcig tu gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de la dmigs nas slob dpon gyis hūm̐ zhes gdangs dang bcas te brjod pa'i rkyen gyis khyed rang rnams 'od kyi gong bur gyur pa de nyid slob dpon gyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar rjes su chags pa'i mes 'od du zhu/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi padmar babs pa las/ khyed rang rnams skad cig gis rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma'i sku can rer gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ slar yang slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i am̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs/ slob dpon gyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar rjes chags kyi mes 'od du zhu/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad mar babs/ khyed rang rnams rje btsun rdo rje bdag med mar gsal ba'i spyi bo nas thim pas khyed rang rnams la dbang bskur ba dang / ye shes pa 'dres pa dus gcig la byung ba'i mos pa mdzod/ slar yang slob dpon gyis hūm̐ zhes brjod pas rkyen gyis khyed rang rnams bdag med ma'i nga rgyal gyis yum gyi dku g.yon pa nas 'thon te/ rang rang gi gral la 'god pa'i mos pa mdzod/ nang gi dbang bskur ba'i dgos pa ni/ dbang gi dngos gzhi ma thob bar gyi gsang ba'i chos rnams nyan pa'i snod rung du bya ba dang / slob dpon la gsang sgrogs mi 'byung ba'i don du bsgrub pa lags/ bzhi pa khyad par can gyi don du zhu ba'i phyir/ bla ma dang rje btsun bdag med ma gnyis su med pa la sta gon gyi chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal zhig 'bul ba zhu/ de ltar maṇḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ bdag med ma yis mgrin 'khyud pa'i/

/dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol/ /byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon pos bdag ni bzhugs su gsol/ /de ltar gsol ba btab nas/ lnga pa gsang sngags la spro ba bskyed pa 'di la gsan pas khyab par gda'/ bu tshur theg pa chen po ste/ /khyod ni tshul chen snod yin te/ /gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga ni/ khyod la yang dag bstan par bya/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang 'das dang / /de bzhin gang dag ma byon dang / /da ltar byung ba'i rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /'gro la phan phyir bzhugs pa kun/ /de dag kun gyis gsang sngags kyi/ /cho ga bzang po 'di mkhyen nas/ /dpa' bos byang chub shing drung du/ /thams cad mkhyen pa tshad med brnyes/ /gsang sngags sbyor ba mnyam med des/ /shwakya seṅge skyob pa yis/ /drag po chen po bdud kyi sde/ /stobs chen dag kyang des bcom ste/ /'jig rten mthun par gshegs nas ni/ /'khor lo bskor nas mya ngan 'das/ /de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir/ /bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig /de'i don ni 'di yin te/ khyed rnams chos kyi bu yin par ma tshad/ nang gi dbang bskur ba'i dus su/ rig mas bskrun pa'i bu yin pas na bu zhes nye ba'i tshig gis bos nas/ khyed rnams thabs snying rje chen po dang / shes rab stong pa gnyis ldan pas theg pa chen po'i chos kyi snod yin la/ theg pa chen po la yang shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa dang / gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa gnyis las/ mchog tu gyur pa tshul chen po gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa khyod la bshad par bya ste/ rdo rje theg pa 'di ni dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad gshegs pa'i shul lam/

bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam yin te/ sngar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyang 'di la brten nas sangs rgyas/ ma 'ongs pa na 'byon par 'gyur ba'i sangs rgyas rnams kyang 'di la brten nas 'tshang rgya/ da ltar gyi ston pa shākya'i rgyal po yang nang ltar du gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i lam la brten nas/ srod la bdud btul/ gung la mnyam par bzhag tho rang mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas mdzad pa bcu gnyis la sogs pa'i sgo nas chos kyi 'khor lo rgya che bskor ba yin pas na/ khyed rang rnams kyang rdo rje theg pa'i lam 'di dang mjal ba ni skal ba bzang pa yin pas/ blo 'di las gzhan du ma gyur bar dga' ba dang spro ba rgya chen po bsgom par gyis shig drug pa rgyun bshags sngon du 'gro bas byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma lha mo bco lnga'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyi bskor nas bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar khyed rang rnams 'khod nas sems can thams cad dang thun mong du sdig pa bshags pa dang / gzhan gyi dge ba la rjes su yi rang ba dang / kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa la sogs pa yan lag bdun pa tshul bzhin du bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gyi bar du mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ sogs rjes zlos byed du gzhug bdun pa bsrung ba bya ba'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ slob dpon la gus 'dud drag po dung pa zhig byas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i am̐ las 'od zer bskal pa'i me lta bu 'phros/ khyod rang rnams kyi lus la phog pas tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad bsregs shing sbyangs/ khyad par dbang bskur ba la bar du gcod par byed pa'i bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad pa'i mos pa mdzod/

ces dang / rdo rje gsor zhing yum gyi phreng sngags lan gsum bzlas la bar chad bsrung / de nas byin gyis rlabs pa'i don du khyed rang rnams bdag med ma'i rang bzhin he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis par gsal lam ste bzhugs pa'i gnas gsum du/ slob dpon gyis dri'i chu rdo rje dang bcas pa reg pa la brten nas byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ lag pa g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i mthe bos mthe'u chung mnan/ gung mdzub srin lag gsum gshib par brkyangs pa'i rtses/ g.yon gyis ting la sogs pa'i nang gi dri bzang gi chu blangs pa slob ma'i dpral bar reg cing oṃ zhes brjod/ de bzhin du mgrin par āḥ snying khar hūm̐/ zhes brjod pa la brten nas/ dpral bar a las zla ba'i steng du oṃ las 'khor lo oṃ gyi mtshan pa las sku rdo rje ma dkar mo/ mgrin par āḥlas zla ba'i steng du āḥlas padma āḥs mtshan pa las gsung rdo rje ma dmar mo/ snying khar ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las thugs rdo rje ma sngon mo/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma g.yas gri gug dang / g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba thugs kar 'dzin pa/ gru mo na kha ṭwāṃ ga dang / rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa rnams gsal lam ste byung ba'i mos pa mdzod/ slar yang mas yar reg ste snying khar hūm̐/ mgrin par āḥ/ dpral bar oṃ/ zhes brjod cing gsal btab/ yang gong bzhin yas mar reg ste/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod cing brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces slob ma gral mgo na su yod gcig la byas tshar ba dang / dmigs pa 'di bzhin thams cad kyis mdzad pa zhu zhig ces brda sbyar grub pa dang / khyed rang rnams kyi gnas gsum gyi rdo rje ma gsum las yig 'bru gsum dang / 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum dpag tu med pa 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs khar phog pas/

thugs ka nas sku gsung thugs rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin yi ge 'bru gsum dang 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum gyi rnam pa can dpag tu med pa byon nas/ khyed rang rnams kyi gnas gsum gyi rdo rje ma gsum la thim pas tha mal gyi lus ngag yid gsum sbyangs te/ lus ngag yid gsum de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ brgyad pa mchod pa ni/ de ltar khyed rnams sems bskyed cing sgo gsum lhar byin gyis brlabs ma thag pa de nyid mchod pa'i yul du bzung ba yin pas/ thog mar me tog dbu la phul ba'i mos pa mdzod/ ces re re'i mgo bor nas 'bras gang rung gtor zhing / oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐/ reng bu la sogs pa'i spos kyis bdug cing bdug spos shangs la phul ba'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badzra dhuppe āḥhūm̐/ mar me bskor zhing / mar me spyan lam du phul ba'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badzra āḥlo ke āḥhūm̐/ dri'i chu 'thor yab kyis snying kar 'thor zhing / dri'i chu thugs kar phul ba'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badzra ghandhe āḥhūm̐/ zhal zas bskor zhing swa ti ka la sogs pa'i zhal zas ljags la phul ba'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badzra nai wi dye āḥhūm̐/ de ltar mchod pa rgyas pa rnams kyis mchod nas/ dgu pa dngos grub kyi bltas brtag pa'i phyir so shing sbyin dgos pas zhes brjod la slob dpon gyis so shing blang ste ku sha'i rtsa bas las bum gyi chu gtor zhing / a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i so shing sor bcu gnyis pa rtse mor me tog dang bcas pa rdo rje slob ma rnams kyi dngos grub kyi ltas brtag pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ yum gyi phreng sngags tshar gcig gi mjug tu oṃ dziṃ hwa badzra saṃ wardha ni swāhā/ zhes pa lan gsum tsam brjod do/ de ltar mngon par bsngags pa'i so shing de nyid khyed rang rnams kyi phyag thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du sbyin pa'i mos pa mdzod/

oṃ dziṃ hwa badzra saṃ wardha ni swāhā/ zhes pas byin la so shing de nyid rin po che gser ram dngul las grub par mos te/ khyed rang rnams kyi sos nem gyis drud pa la brten nas/ tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad sman pa mkhas pas skyug sman btang ba bzhin bskyugs te/ so shing la thim pas so shing brjid dang ldan par bsam pa de nyid tshom bu dbus ma'i steng du dor ba'i mos pa mdzad nas oṃ badzra ha sa ha zhes gsungs shing thal mo kha phye ste/ tshom bu dbus ma'i steng du ltos pa med par dor cig ces brjod la/ so shing gi ra ba khru gru bzhi dri bzang gis byugs pa la tshom bu dgu dgod pa'i dbus su dor te/ rtse mo de nyid rang dang bla ma la bstan na phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob/ steng du bstan na mkha' spyod/ 'og tu bstan na sa 'og gi dngos grub/ shar du zhi ba/ lhor mngon spyod/ nub tu dbang / byang du rgyas pa/ mtshams rnams su bstan na bum pa bzang po la sogs pa'i dngos grub phran tshegs ci rigs pa 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /so shing gis kha la sogs pa'i lus gtso che ba'i dri ma sbyong ba bzhin/ bum dbang gis kyang gtso bor lus kyi dri ma sbyong bar byed pas bum dbang gi sta gon yin no/ /bcu pa rmi lam gsal por 'byung ba dang ngag gi dri ma sbyong ba'i phyir khyor chu sbyin dgos pas phreng sngags tshar gcig dang / oṃ hrī bi shuddha sarba dharmāḥsarba pā paṃ ni tsa sya saṃ sho dha ya/ sarba bi kalpān a pa na ya hūm̐ zhes gsum tsam brjod la/ de ltar mngon par bsngags pa'i dri'i chu de nyid khyed rang rnams kyi khyor ba g.yas par lan gsum du sbyin pa la brten nas tshe thog med nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa rtsa nang gi ljan ljin mi gtsang ba thams cad sbyang pa'i mos pa mdzod/ gong gi hrīḥbi shuddha'i sngags gsum gyis byin la/

de ltar khyor chus ngag gi dri ma dag par byed pa bzhin/ gsang dbang gis ngag gi dri ma sbyong par byed pas gsang dbang gi sta gon yin no/ bcu gcig pa rmi lam dang dngos grub la bar chad mi 'byung ba'i phyir srung skud sbyin pa ni/ srung skud a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i srad bu dmar po slob ma'i lus tshad dang mnyam pa gsum sgril du byas pa la rdo rje mdud pa gsum gyi btab pas rdo rje slob ma'i lus ngag yid gsum gyi bar chad bsrung ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ slob dpon gyi snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas sta gon gyi lha dbang bskur sbrel nas byed na/ gnyis pa man la dkyil 'khor lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs ka nas ye shes kyi srad bu sogs brjod/ rnams kyi thugs khar phog pas/ thugs kha nas ye shes kyi srad bu'i tshogs dpag tu med pa byung nas/ dam tshig gi srad bu la thim zhes brjod cing / srung skud thal mo'i bar du bzung la phreng sngags ji ltar rigs pa bzlas shing kha rlangs phog pa byas/ de ltar mngon par bsngags pa'i srad bu de nyid skyes pa rnams kyi dpung pa g.yon dang / bud med rnams kyi g.yas su nyis skor du bcings/ las bum gyi chus gtor zhing / gur nas 'byung bas yi ge brgya pas brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badzra satwa sa mā ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badzra satwa twe no pa tiṣṭha ḍi ḍho me bhā wa/ su po ṣyo me bhā wa/ a nu rakto me bhā wa/ su to ṣyo me bhā wa/ sha shwa twa me bhā wa/ hri da ya me a dhi tiṣṭha sarba si ddhiṃ me pra yatstsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsittaṃ shrī ye ku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wān/ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra ma me muñdza badzri bhā wa ma hā sa ma ya satwa aḥ zhes brjod cing brtan par bya ba ste srung skud btags pa ni shes rab ye shes kyi sbyang gzhi khams kyi bar chad bsrung ba'i phyir du yin pa bzhin/

shes rab ye shes kyang khams bdud rtsi la dbang bskur ba yin pas/ shes rab ye shes kyi sta gon no/ /bcu gnyis pa rmi lam mi 'khrul cing gsal po 'byung ba'i phyir ku sha'i sngas stan sbyin dgos pas/ ku sha ring thung slob ma'i grangs dang mthun pa phon che chung gnyis gong bzhin bum chus bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i ku sha sngo ljang rtsa ba dang rtse mo ma nyams pa/ rdo rje slob ma rnams kyi rmi lam mi 'khrug cing gsal por 'byung ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ āḥ.a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ am̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swāhā/ tshar gnyis bzlas/ dhīḥha gsum brjod nas byin gyis rlabs pa'i ku sha chung ba sngas kyi don du phyag g.yas dang / che ba stan gyi don du phyag g.yon du byin pa'i mos pa mdzod byas la/ dhīḥha zhes pas sbyin/ de lta bu'i ku sha 'dag byed kyi rdzas bla na med pa yin pa ltar/ dbang bzhi pa'i ye shes kyis kyang mtshan ma dang rnam par rtog pa thams cad 'dag par byed pas ku sha sbyin pa dbang bzhi pa'i sta gon yin zhing / sngon bcom ldan 'das ku sha ma 'khrugs pa'i stan la bzhugs nas sangs rgyas pa bzhin khyed rang rnams kyang ku sha'i stan la nyal te/ rmi lam sgyu ma lta bu mngon du byas nas sangs rgya ba'i rten 'brel lam du byed pa de lags/ bcu gsum pa zab mo chos bshad pa'i sgo nas spro ba bskyed pa 'di la gsan pas khyab par gda'/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag /u dum wa ra'i me tog ltar/ /brgya lam na ni res 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ngo / /gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba/ /de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste/ /gang gi sems can mnyam med don/ /bla med byed par nus pa yin/ /bskal pa bye ba du mar ni/ /sngon du sdig pa byas pa gang / /dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra mthong ma thag /de dag zad par 'gyur yin na/ /grags pa mtha' yas sngags spyod pa'i/

/tshul la gnas na smos ci dgos/ /skyob pa'i gsang sngags bzlas na ni/ /go 'phang bla na med par 'gyur/ /gang dag spyod pa mchog 'di la/ /blo gros shin tu mi g.yo na/ /sdug bsngal thams cad 'byung ba yi/ /ngan 'gro de yis gcod par 'gyur/ /bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kyis/ /rnyed pa mnyam med de ring rnyed/ /gang phyir rgyal ba sras bcas la/ /bdag nyid chen po kun gyis ni/ /bstan pa 'di la khyed rnams kun/ /yongs su bzung ste skye bzhin pa/ /de phyir khyed rnams theg chen du/ /sang ni rab tu skye bar 'gyur/ /theg pa chen po cher 'byung ba/ /lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan/ /khyed rnams der ni dong bas na/ /rang byung skal ba chen po pa/ /'jig rten thams cad mkhyen pa yi/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyid du 'gyur/ /de'i don ni 'di yin te/ 'jig rten du gang dkon na u dum wa ra'i me tog dkon pa ltar/ sangs rgyas dkon te sangs rgyas gcig 'jig rten du 'tshang rgya ba'i tshul ston pa na/ de dang khad nye ba'i sa phyogs zhig tu u dum wa ra'i me tog gcig 'byung / de yang rgyal rigs las 'byon na dkar po/ bram ze'i rigs las 'byon na ser po 'byung la/ sangs rgyas de yum gyi lhums su zhugs pa na me tog de kha 'bus/ bltams pa na kha bye/ gzhon nu rol rtsed mdzad pa na rgyas/ dka' thub mdzad pa na rnying / 'tshang rgya ba'i tshul bstan pa na rgyas/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba na shin tu rgyas/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul bstan pa na skam nas 'gro ste/ des na de gnyis ka dkon mtshungs yin pas sangs rgyas 'jig rten du 'byon pa dkon/ byon nas chos gsung pa dkon/ chos kyi nang nas theg pa chen po'i chos gsung pa dkon/ theg chen gyi nang nas kyang gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa gsung pa shin tu dkon te/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa ni 'das pa'i sangs rgyas mar me mdzad nas 'od srung gi bar gyis kyang ma gsungs/

ma 'ongs pa na 'byon par 'gyur ba'i sangs rgyas byams pa nas/ mos pa'i bar gyis kyang gsung bar mi 'gyur/ des na da ltar gyi ston pa mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po 'di kho na sngon gyi smon lam gyi stobs kyis gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa gsung pas na shin tu dkon/ dkon pas ci phan ri bong gi rwa dang nam mkha'i me tog kyang dkon snyam na/ de dag dang mi mtshungs par dkon la phan yon chen po dang ldan pa yin te/ sang nyin dkyil 'khor gyi mtshon rtsi tsam mthong ba'i mod la bskal pa dpag tu med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa thams cad 'dag par 'gyur na/ dbang bskur ba tshul bzhin du nod de lam la brtson 'grus chen po byas na phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par 'gyur bas dga' ba khyad par can bskyed par mdzod cig ces 'bras bu la spro ba bskyed/ de nas bcu bzhi pa rmi lam brtag cing ngan na bsrung ba bya ba'i don du gsang ba spyi rgyud las/ bu kye sang ni dkyil 'khor dag /mthong bar 'gyur ro nyol zhig dang / /rmi lam mthong ba gang yin pa/ /de kun nga la drang por smros/ /zhes gsungs pas do nub rang gi gnas khang du nyal ba'i tshe/ slob dpon gyis sbyin pa'i ku sha chung ba de sngas kyi steng du rtse mo mdun la bstan te 'phrad du bzhag che ba stan du gting nas rtse mo sngas phyogs su bstan/ gos gsar pa dri ma med pa gyon nas glo g.yas pa 'og tu phab ste seṅge nyal stabs kyis nyal/ sems la 'dod chags la sogs pa nyon mongs pa dug gsum kyi rnam rtogs gang yang yid la mi bsam par/ sang nyin dkyil 'khor chen po ji lta bu zhig mthong bar 'gyur ram snyam/ lha dang bla ma yid la dran bzhin pa'i ngang nas dga' spro dung nge nyal ba'i tshe rmi lam du bzang ngan gyi bltas 'byung bas/ de la spyir/ rmi lam thams cad bden min yang / /de la ma dad rigs ma yin/ /zhes gsungs pas/ rmi lam thams cad mi bden pa'i dpe yin yang /

dbang bskur ba'i dus de nyid du dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gros rgyud byin gyis rlabs te lung ston par mdzad pas/ de la rmi lam bzang po'i bltas ni/ gsang ba spyi rgyud las/ rmi lam sangs rgyas mthong na ni/ /yon tan rgya mtsho mngon sum bzhin/ /mchod rten dang ni sku gzugs mthong / /de la mchod pa rtsom pa dang / /dge slong dag la chos nyan tam/ /yang na ma nyan na yang rung / /chos ni rnam par spyod pa dang / /de bzhin mdo sde rnam par spyod/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/ rmi lam du sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs dang / mchod rten mthong zhing phyag dang bskor ba byed pa/ dam pa'i chos kyi glegs bam thogs pa/ dge 'dun gyi sde'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ chos kyi 'bel gtam byed pa/ rang gi bla ma dang mjal zhing chos nyan pa sogs byung na mchog tu 'gyur ba yin/ gzhan yang lus la ngan skyug don pa/ ri 'thon po la 'dzeg pa/ nyi zla shar ba/ nam mkha' la 'phur ba/ rgyal por dbang bskur ba/ rta dang glang po la sogs pa zhon pa bzang po la bzhon pa/ brag phug tu nyi ma lde ba/ zas bzang po ro brgya dang ldan pa thob pa/ 'bru la sogs pa'i bang mdzod kyi gter rnyed pa/ mi mang pos dpon du 'khur zhing gus 'dud byed pa/ skye bo mang po la rang gi chos bshad pa/ pha ma dang mdza' shes dang 'phrad pa/ gos rgyan bzang pos brgyan pa/ dar 'phyar ba/ dung 'bud pa sogs byung na rmi lam bzang po'i bltas yin pas/ zhen chags med pa'i tshul gyi dga' ba bsgom par byed/ gal te ngan pa'ang 'byung srid pas/ de'i ltas ni rgya skyegs kyi ri la 'dzeg pa/ ka ra wī ra'i me tog rgyas pa 'thu ba/ bye ma'i thal phung gi ri la 'dzeg pa/ spre'u dang bong bu la zhon nas kha phyir phyogs te slar mi ldog pa'i tshul gyis 'gro ba/ phag dang rnga mong ma he sogs la zhon pa/ bud med nag mo gos nag can la 'dod log spyad pa/ bud med nag mo shin tu khros pas rang gi lto ba dbral ba/

g.yang sa dang cong rong du lhung ba/ mi nag po lcags kyi dbyug pa can gyis bsdigs pa/ khyis zos pa/ skra bregs pa/ chus khyer ba/ lus la til mar gyis byugs pa/ gos rgyan dmar pos brgyan pa sogs rmi na/ cung zad ngan pa'i bltas yin pas gnyid gsad ma thag tu chos thams cad rmi lam gyi snang ba dang khyad par med de/ don la grub pa cung zad kyang med snyam du bden med kyi lta ba bdag med pas sbyangs ba dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi rtsa ba'i sngags brgya rtsa brgyad du bzlas shing / spyi rgyud las/ mi dge ba la zhi ba yi/ /sbyin bsreg zhi ba'i gsang sngags kyi/ /zhes gsungs pas zhi drag gi sreg blugs brgya rtsa brgyad du 'bul ba dang / sangs rgyas spyan gyi rnal 'byor bla ma brgyud pa'i man ngag las 'byung ba bzhin lung blangs te nyams su len pa sogs/ rmi lam ngan pa bzlog pa'i thabs la brtson par bya dgos so/ /de rnams kyis sta gon gyi chos 'khor dang bcas pa song nas/ dngos gzhi ni sang nyin ji ltar skabs su babs pa la 'byung bas de la mdzad par zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs brjod la slob ma rang gnas su gtang ngo / ༈ /de ltar dbang gi sta gon dag /legs par sbyin te nang par tshe/ /slob dpon bya ba kun rdzogs nas/ /'dang nub sta gon sbyin pa yi/ /slob ma rnams kyis phyag dang yon/ /phul la khrus byas gral la 'khod/ /me tog bkye bsdu sogs grub rjes/ /slob dpon gyis ni 'di skad brjod/ ༈ /'o nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du zab pa las kyang ches zab pa'i rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma lha mo bco lnga'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba zab mo gsan snyam pa byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa dang / chos gsan pa'i kun tu spyod pa yang rdo rje theg pa'i gzhung lugs dri ma med pa nas ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin gnas khang bsrung ba'i 'khor lo dur khrod brgyad gzhal yas khang dang bcas pa'i nang du khyed rang rnams kyi lhag pa'i lha gang yang rung ba'i nga rgyal dang ldan bzhin pas gsan par zhu/

de la 'dir yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsungs pa'i lam rnams kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa rdo rje theg pa'i lam yin zhing / rdo rje theg pa'i lam thams cad smin grol gnyis su bzhed te/ bshad rgyud rdo rje rtse mo las/ smin pa dang ni grol ba'i lam/ /sangs rgyas byang chub bstan pa'i mchog /ces gsungs shing / bdag nyid chen po sa skya paṇḍi tas kyang / rdo rje theg pa'i lam zhugs te/ /myur du sangs rgyas thob 'dod na/ /smin grol gnyis la 'bad par bya/ /zhes gsungs pas lam thams cad smin grol gnyis su gsungs shing / de la thog mar smin byed kyi dbang bskur ba ni shin tu gal che ba yin pas/ de yang rgyud sde bzhi po re re nas dbang gi babs mi 'dra ba bzhi gsungs te/ bya ba'i rgyud las/ chu dang cod pan gyi dbang tsam las ma gsungs/ spyod pa'i rgyud las de'i steng du rdo rje dril bu dang ming gi dbang bskur ba gsungs shing / rnal 'byor rgyud las de rnams kyi steng du phyir mi ldog pa rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang bskur bar gsung / rnal 'byor bla med las thun mong du rig pa'i dbang lnga/ brtul zhugs dang bcas pa/ de'i steng du rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang dang / dbang gong ma gsum ste dbang bzhi dang / grol lam la rim pa gnyis gsung ste/ de la dgongs nas/ sa skya paṇḍi tas/ dbang bzhi dang ni rim pa gnyis/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i khyad chos yin/ /zhes gsungs pas/ des na gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa la rten 'brel gnad du che ba yin zhing / rten 'brel de yang dbang gi dus nas 'grig pa zhig dgos te/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir wa pa'i dgongs pa/ rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras kyi bzhed pas sangs rgyas thob pa'i rten 'brel thams cad dbang bzhi'i sgo nas 'grig dgos par gsungs shing / sa skya pa chen pos/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir wa pa/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa la/

/rten 'brel gnad du che bar bzhed/ /rten 'brel rtsa ba dbang bskur yin/ /rten 'brel dbang las sgrig dgos pas/ /mtshan nyid ldan pa'i bla ma la/ /dbang bzhi rdzogs par thob nas ni/ /zhes gsungs/ rje btsun rin po ches/ bla ma brgyud pa dang ldan rgyud don rig /dam tshig mchog bsrung man ngag du mas brgyan/ /snying rjes rgyud brlan bstan bcos du ma shes/ /de yis zhabs bsten gsol ba lan mang btab/ /de yi nang nas dkyil 'khor chen po ru/ /zhugs la dbang bzhi po rnams rdzogs par blangs/ /byin rlabs phra mo tsam gcig ma yin te/ /sngags kyi rtsa ba dbang bskur yin pas so/ /zhes gsungs pa'i 'di pa'i gnas skabs su smin byed kyi dbang bskur ba'i dkyil 'khor yang rgyud sde nas gsungs pa zhig dgos te/ bdag nyid chen po sa skya paṇṭi tas/ deng sang gang zag rab 'bring kun/ /rdul tshon gyi ni dkyil 'khor du/ /dbang bskur bya bar gsungs mod gyi/ /gzhan gyi smin byed rgyud las bkag /ces gsungs pas dkyil 'khor yang rgyud sde rnam par dag pa nas gsungs pa'i rdul tshon nam/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor mtshan nyid dang ldan par dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs par bskur dgos pa yin gyis/ gzhan g.yung drung ris dang / nas 'dra la sogs byed pa'i dkyil 'khor du phag mgo dang / gtor ma'i dbang bskur ba dang / /rdo rje phag mo'i byin rlabs sogs kyis smin byed kyi dbang gi go mi chod ste/ bdag nyid chen po sa skya paṇṭi tas/ g.yung drung ris kyi dkyil 'khor dang / /nas 'dra la sogs byed pa thos/ /'di 'dra dag tu dbang bskur yang / /sdom pa thob par mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang / gtor ma'i dbang bskur zhes bya dang / /ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bskur yang / /slob ma smin byed cho ga ru/ /rgyud sde kun las gsungs pa med/ /ces dang / /gang zag rab 'bring gsum ga la/ /phag mo'i byin brlabs smin byed du/

/rgyud sde kun las gsungs pa med/ /ces dang / des na snying gtam 'di ltar yin/ gsang sngags rten 'brel lam byed pa/ /rten 'brel bsgrigs pa'i gdam ngag yin/ /phung po khams dang skye mched la/ /sangs rgyas sa bon btab nas ni/ /tshe 'dir sangs rgyas byed pa yi/ /thabs la dbang bskur zhes su btags/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ phung po khams dang skye mched la sangs rgyas kyi sa bon btab nas/ tshe 'di nyid la bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob par byed pa'i phyi nang gi rten 'brel bsgrig nus pa'i thabs khyad par can zhig la/ smin byed kyi dbang bskur ba mtshan nyid par 'jog pa yin/ mtshan nyid pa de lta bu'i dbang la yang / rgyu lam 'bras bu'i dbang gsum las/ rgyu dus kyi dbang bskur ba yin zhing / de la rje btsun yab la brten pa dang / yum la brten pa gnyis las/ 'dir yum la brten pa yin la/ de lta bu'i dbang bskur ba ma thob pa'i nyes dmigs ni/ phyag chen thig le las/ dbang ma bskur la dngos grub med/ /bye ma rtsir bas mar med ltar/ /gang zhig rgyud lung nga rgyal gyis/ /dbang bskur med par 'chad byed pa/ /slob dpon slob ma shi ma thag /dngos grub thob kyang dmyal bar skye/ /de bas 'bad pa thams cad kyis/ /bla ma la ni dbang nod zhu/ /zhes gsungs/ sa paṇa gyis/ mdor na chos kyi ci byed soms/ /sangs rgyas byed na chos bzhin gyis/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa dbang bskur ma thob pa'i nyes dmigs shes pa'i sgo nas/ dbang la nan tan snying po bya dgos so/ /dbang bskur thob pa'i phan yon ni/ gsang ba spyi rgyud las/ dbang bskur yang dag sbyin ldan na/ /skye zhing skye bar dbang bskur 'gyur/ /de yi skye ba bdun du ni/ /ma bsgom par yang dngos grub thob/ /ces gsungs/ slob dpon padmas dam tshig lnga par/ gal te ltung ba med gyur na/ /skye ba bcu drug dag nas 'grub/ /ces bya ba la sogs pa'i phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig yod der ma zad dbang bskur bas grol byed dang smin byed gnyis ka'i lam du'ang 'gyur ba yin te/

sa paṇa gyis/ des na gang zag dbang po rab/ /dbang bskur nyid kyis grol bar gsungs/ /dbang gis grol bar ma nus pa'i/ /gang zag gzhan la bsgom dgos so/ /zhes gsungs pas/ dbang po yang rab rgyal po ind+ra bhu ti lta bu dbang bskur ba'i dus nyid du grol bar gsungs pa ltar/ gang zag dbang po 'bring dang tha ma rnams/ dbang bskur nas bsgom par bya ba yin te/ sdom gsum las/ des na dbang bskur thob pa de/ /bsrung zhing 'phel bar byed pa la/ /bsgom pa zhes byar btags pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pas dbang gi don bsgom pa ma gtogs gzhan lam bsgom pa zhes bya ba gang yang med pas/ smin grol gnyis ka'i rtsa ba dbang bskur ba yin/ de ltar thob nas lam la brtson 'grus bskyed de rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor la 'bad na/ brtson 'grus rab phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub tshe 'dir thob par 'gyur la/ 'bring 'chi kha'am bar dor/ tha ma skye ba bdun nam bcu drug tshun la bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa mngon du 'gyur bar byed pa yin pas/ de lta bu'i dbang bskur ba la sta gon du gnas pa dang / dngos gzhi gnyis las/ sta gon gyi chos dgos pa rnams kha sang gi gnas skabs su legs par song nas/ da lan dngos gzhi skabs su babs pa yin zhing / dngos gzhi'i cho ga la bri zhing rgyan dgram pa/ bsgrub cing mchod pa/ 'jug cing dbang blang pa/ rjes kyi cho ga ste rnam pa bzhi yod pa las/ dang po bri ba la thig gis bri ba/ tshon gyis bri ba/ mtshan ma dgod pa/ rgyan dgram pa ste bzhi/ gnyis pa bsgrub cing mchod pa la/ bdag bskyed sngon du song ba'i sgo nas/ dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor 'byin pa'i tshul gyis bsgrub pa dang / bskyed mched sku gsung thugs byin gyis rlabs pa'i tshul gyis bsgrub pa dang / ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor spyan drangs pa'i tshul gyis bsgrub pa dang / dbang bskur zhing rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas btab pa'i tshul gyis bsgrub pa ste/

rnam pa bzhi'i bsgrub nas nang du dkyil 'khor la mchod pas mnyes par bya ba dang / phyi rol du 'byung po'i tshogs gtor mas tshim par bya ba rnams dgos te zhes brda sprad/ ras bris yin na gong gi dngos gzhi'i cho ga la zhes pa'i rjes su bdag bskyed sngon du song ba'i zhes pa man brjod la/ 'jug cing dbang blang pa la slob dpon bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba dang / slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ slob ma la dbang ji tsam bskur ba thams cad/ slob dpon rang nyid kyis bdag 'jug gi tshul du len dgos pas/ phyi nang gi mkha' 'gro rnams mchod gtor gyis mnyes par bya ba'i bar/ da lan gyi gnas skabs su legs par grub zin/ slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur ba la lha dang skal ba mnyam pa'i ched du/ slob dpon la rdo rje bdag med ma dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus dang ldan pa'i sgo nas/ dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal zhig 'bul ba zhu/ de ltar maṇḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gyi bar du mdzod/ bdag med ma yis mgrin 'khyud pa'i/ /sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ de ltar gsol ba btab nas dkyil 'khor du 'jug dgos pa yin pas/ de ltar zhugs nas dam tshig gi sdom pa thob par byed pa la khas blangs dang cho ga'i sgo nas thob par bya ba gnyis las/ khas blangs kyi sgo nas thob par bya ba la 'dzin rgyu'i dam tshig 'di dang 'di yin no/ /zhes sdom pa bsgrags pa 'di la gsan pas khyab par gda' ste/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ sogs nas/ gsang ba'i rgyud las rab tu bshad/ ces pa'i bar brjod la/ de'i don ni 'di yin te/ 'di la gsang sngags kyi sdom pa'i bslab bya/ so so thar pa'i bslab bya/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab bya dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ rigs lnga so so'i dam tshig yin pas/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs gnas su mi brjed par 'dzin pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi dam tshig

rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya'i de kho na nyid gsum dang / slob dpon rnams mi brjed par bzung ba bzhi mi bskyod pa'i dam tshig zang zing gi sbyin pa/ mi 'jigs pa'i sbyin pa/ chos kyi sbyin pa/ byams pa'i sbyin pa ste/ sbyin pa rnam pa bzhi po nyin lan gsum mtshan lan gsum ste dus drug tu gtong ba'am 'dun pa ma bral bar byed pa rin chen 'byung ldan gyi dam tshig phyi ste bya spyod rnal 'byor rgyud gsum/ gsang ba rnal 'byor bla na med pa ste rgyud sde chen po bzhi dang / nyan thos rang rgyal/ theg pa chen po/ pha rol tu phyin pa rnams nas bshad pa'i chos ma lus pa 'dzin pa 'od dpag med kyi dam tshig sngar gyi dam tshig rnams kyi steng du/ dran shes bzhin bsten pa'i sgo nas dkon mchog gsum la mchod pa'i las ci nus su bya dgos pa don yod grub pa'i dam tshig ste/ mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus gyis/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ so so thar ba dang / byang sems kyi bslab bya rnams rigs lnga spyi'i dam tshig yin pas dang po so thar ni/ khyod kyis srog chags bsad mi bya/ /zhes pa nas/ chang ni rnam par spangs bar bya'i bar gyis bstan te/ so thar sdom pa'i bslab bya rtsa ba bzhi chang dang lnga po gzhan don du 'gyur na ma gtogs bsrung dgos pa yin no/ byang sems kyi bslab bya la spyi dang / so so'i bslab bya gnyis las/ dang po spyi ni/ de las gzhan yang bcu bzhi ni/ zhes pa nas sbom por 'gyur gyi bar sho lo ka gnyis kyis bstan pa ni/ nam mkha'i snying po'i mdo nas bshad pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rgyal po la 'byung ba'i ltung ba gcig blon po la 'byung ba'i ltung ba gcig rgyal blon thun mong du 'byung ba bzhi/ byang chub sems dpa' las dang po la 'byung ba brgyad de bcu bzhi po rnams bsrung dgos/ so so'i bslab bya la nyes spyod sdom pa'i bslab bya ni/ lus kyi las ni rnam gsum dang /

/zhes pa nas ci nus par ni rjes su skyongs/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan pa ste mi dge bcu spong dgos/ dge ba chos bsdud ni/ dam pa nye bar bsten bya zhing / /rnal 'byor pa kun bsnyen bkur bya/ /zhes pas bstan te dge ba spyod pa'i grogs skyes bu dam pa dang / rnal 'byor pa rnams la dad gus kyis sgo nas bsten cing bsnyen bkur phun sum tshogs pa byas pa la brten nas dge ba bcu spyod pa ste/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i nyams len thams cad 'dus pa yin no/ /sems can don byed ni/ theg pa dman la 'dod mi bya/ /zhes pa nas/ khyod kyis rtag tu bsrung bar bya/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan te/ sems can gyi don byed pa'i mi mthun phyogs de rnams spangs pa'i sgo nas sems can gyi don bsgrub dgos shing / gzhan ma dad par gyur pa'i cha la sogs pa'i 'gro ba su la'ang brnyas par mi bya ba dang / bla ma khyim pa'i phyag rgya dang / lha'i phyag mtshan sogs gang la yang 'gom par mi bya ba ste de dag spong dgos so/ /der ma zad de dag dang rjes su mthun pa'i sdom pa rnams kyang bsrung dgos te/ rjes mthun sdom pa rgya cher ni/ /gsang ba'i rgyud las rab tu bshad/ /ces gsung ba ste/ gsang ba spyi rgyud las gsungs ba'i bya ba'i rgyud kyi rtsa ltung bcu bzhi/ rnam snang mngon byang las gsungs pa'i rtsa ltung bzhi po rnams kyang bsrung dgos so/ /de lta bu'i dam tshig dang sdom pa rnams 'dzin dgos pas dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ ces sogs kyis brda sprad la/ sta gon gyi skabs ltar/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /zhes sogs lan gsum gyis sta gon ltar rgyud dag par byas nas/ thun mong ma yin pa'i rigs lnga spyi bye brag gis bsdus pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa rnams tshul bzhin du bzung bar bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gyi bar du mdzod/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang /

/sogs nas/ sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god/ /ces pa'i bar brjod/ de ltar dam tshig dang sdom pa 'dzin par khas blangs nas/ khyed rang rnams sngon chad bcom ldan 'das rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma lha mo bco lnga'i dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa'am/ zhugs kyang bskyar nas 'jug pa'i don du dar yug dmar po res gdong bcings pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ā khaṃ wī ra hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing slob ma du yod la mig ras bcings tshar ba dang / dkyil 'khor gyi lha dang mjal ba de'i tshe phyag stong par mjal du mi rung bas phyag rten gyi slad du u dum wa ra la sogs pa me tog gi chun chang re gtad pa'i mos pa mdzod/ āḥkhaṃ wī ras me tog tsam pa ka dang / slon dpon rdo rje bdag med mar gsal ba'i thugs kha nas khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spros nas khyed rang rnams la dbang bskur ba la phyi'i bar du gcod pa thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces dang / las bum gyi chu ku sha'i rtsa bas slob ma re re la gtor zhing / oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇṭa li sogs brjod cing bar chad thams cad bsrung / de ltar phyi'i bar du gcod pa thams cad bsrung bdud rtsi byin zhing 'bru gsum brjod pa la brten nas nang gi bar chad thams cad bsrung ba'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod cing nang mchod la sogs pa bdud rtsi'i snod gang yin nas slob ma la bdud rtsi byin zhing 'bru gsum brjod pa ste 'di ma chad pa gal che'o/ /rigs nges par bya ba'i don du rigs can gsum gyi nang nas rigs gang yin/ spyod pa ci la dga'/ zhes khyed rnams la 'dod pa 'dri ba yin te/ bu khyod su yin ci la dga'/ /zhes dris pas bdag skal ba bzang po spyod pa bde ba chen po la dga'o/ /zhes pa'i lan btab pa'i mos pa mdzad nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ skal bzang bdag bde ba chen po la'o/ /spyod pa bde ba chen pos dgos pa ci bsgrub ces 'dri ba yin te/

de yis bu la ci zhig bya/ /zhes dris pas/ dgos pa sems can gyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par 'dod ces lan btab par mos nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sangs rgyas mchog gi dam tshig go /dgos pa sems can gyi don du sangs rgyas thob pa de bden gnyis dbyer med du sems bskyed dgos pas dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya snyam pa kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems dung pa re bskyed mdzod/ de nyid gzugs kyi rnam par langs te khyed rang rnams kyi snying khar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor cha shas yongs su rdzogs pa nya gang pa lta bu zhig gsal lam gyis byung ba'i mos pa mdzod/ chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs stong pa'i mtha' dang bral ba bde stong nam mkha' lta bu'o snyam pa'i don dam byang chub kyi sems dung pa re bskyed mdzod/ de nyid gzugs kyi rnam par langs te zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa 'od zer rab tu 'phro ba dang bcas pa re gsal lam gyi byung ba'i mos pa mdzod/ de ltar zla ba ni kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems rdo rje ni don dam byang chub kyi sems te bden pa gnyis dbyer med du sems bskyed snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsitta utpā da yā mi/ snying khar rdo rje bzhag pa'i sgo nas brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ su ra te sa ma ya satwaṃ ho siddha badzra ya thā su khaṃ zhes slob ma re re'i snying khar rdo rje bzhag de ltar bden gnyis dbyer med du sems bskyed pa dang / 'og nas 'byung ba'i gsang sngags kyi kun tu spyod pa snod dang mi ldan pa rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya'o zhes gsang bar gdams pa yin te/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi rigs su rab tu zhugs kyi/

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang chen dam pa 'di de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ ma dad pa rnams la yang ma yin no/ /zhes brjod cing slob ma re re'i mgor rdo rje bzhag nang du 'jug pa'i don du khyed rang rnams slob dpon gyi lag gi rdo rje la 'jus te dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo nas zhugs te gtso bo'i drung du khrid par mos/ dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs la dbu dud pa re mdzad nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hūm̐ dzaḥhūm̐/ de rnams kyis phyi'i 'jug pa song nas/ nang du 'jug pa la sngon du 'gro ba dam la bzhag pa bzhi dang / dngos gzhi ye shes dbab pa rnam pa gnyis las/ thog mar phan yon gyi sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ slob ma rnams kyi spyi bor rdo rje bzhag la/ ye shes gang gis khyed de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob par 'gyur na/ dngos grub gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos/ de lta bu'i rdo rje'i ye shes bskyed par bya yis/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor chen po ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ bu khyod dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ta re/ yang rdo rje snying khar bzhag la nyes dmigs kyi sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ bdag med ma dpal deng khyod kyi/ /snying la yang dag zhugs par gyur/ /gal te tshul 'di smras na ni/ /de ma thag tu bral te gshegs/ /slar yang spyi bor rdo rje bzhag nas/ /nyes dmigs kyi sgo nas dam la bzhag pa yin te/ 'di ni khyod kyi dam tshig gi rdo rje ste/ gal te tshul 'di su yang rung ba la smras na 'dis khyod kyi mgo bo 'gem par 'gyur ro/ /rnam rgyal bum chu dang bdud rtsi bsres pa dung chos su blug nas byin la/ phan yon dang nyes dmigs gnyis ka'i sgo nas dam la bzhag pa yin te/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na bsreg par byed/

/dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub ni/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub/ /oṃ pañtsa a mṛ ta u da ka ṭha ṭha ṭha zhes brjod cing slob ma'i lag par sbyin/ yang spyi bor rdo rje bzhag la/ bla ma'i bka' gnyan pa'i sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ deng phyin chad bu khyod kyi dpal rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma nga yin gyi/ ngas 'di byos shig ces bya ba 'di khyod kyis bya dgos/ nga la yang brnyas pa ma byed cig byas na ya nga ba ma spangs par 'chi ba'i dus byas nas sems can dmyal ba chen por ltung bar gyur ta re zhes dam la bzhag de rnams kyis sngon du 'gro ba dam la bzhag pa rnams song nas/ dngos gzhi ye shes dbab pa zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal zhig 'bul bar zhu/ de ltar maṇḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gyi bar du mdzod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyis rlobs shig rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma bdag la dbab tu gsol/ zhes brjod/ de ltar gsol ba btab nas khyed rang rnams lus tsog pur byas nas/ gang la yang ma snyes par me tog dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar te sems ma yengs par dngos po dang mtshan ma gang la yang ma zhen pa'i ngang nas/ skad cig gis bdag med ma'i rang bzhin he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i rnam pa can gyis langs nas yod pa'i rkang pa gnyis bgrad pa'i 'og tu yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu gdungs pa lta bu chang bzung thur du bstan zhing / mchog ma gnyis gyen du bstan pa la g.yo ba'i ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng rkang mthil gnyis su yi ge dzhaiṃ ljang khu drag cing bzod par dka' ba me rlung gi rang bzhin can sku lus gyen du 'phul bzhin pa dang bcas pa re re/ sum mdor ram̐ las byung ba'i me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po ram̐ dang me 'bar bas mtshan pa/ snying khar lam̐ las byung ba'i sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po zur bzhir rdo rje rtse gsum pas mtshan pa'i lte ba la hūm̐/

mgrin par wam̐ las byung ba'i chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pa dang āḥs mtshan pa/ spyi bor yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor du ba 'khrigs pa lta bu la haṃ yis mtshan pa ste 'byung bzhi'i dkyil 'khor gsal lam ste byung bar mos nas/ slob dpon la rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma dngos yin snyam du gus 'dud drag po dung pa re byas pa'i slob dpon gyi thugs kha nas 'od zer 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi rkang 'og gi rlung la phog pas rlung g.yos rkang mthil gyi dzhaiṃ mer 'bar/ long bu gnyis nas zhugs/ brla'i rtsa bo che na yar dmar khyug ste song bas/ sum mdor gzhir gnas kyi me dang khrug chil te 'dres pa las me de cher 'bar ba'i stobs kyi snying kha'i sa'i dkyil 'khor de tsha lam gyis bsros/ mgrin pa'i chu'i dkyil 'khor de skya thi li li bskol ba'i rlangs pa gyen du song bas spyi bo'i rlung la phog pas spyi bo'i rlung g.yos thur du bus pas mgrin pa'i chu'i zegs ma snying kha'i sa la sib sib babs pas yas mar bdud rtsi babs pas bde ba/ mas yar me 'bar bas drod skyes te snying khar bde drod 'dzom pa la sems gtad/ de'i dus su rkang 'og gi rlung gis yar bteg spyi bo'i rlung gis thur du mnan te lus bar snang du 'dar yom yom gnas pa de'i tshe/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul bas/ de dag gi thugs ka nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma lha mo bco lnga'i rnam pa can che ba ri rab tsam/ chung ba rdul phran tsam gyi tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa byon nas khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo dang / ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas kha ba chen po babs pa bzhin sib sib thim pa la brten nas khyed rang rnams kyi rgyud la dbang gi ye shes khyad par can skyes pa'i mos pa mdzod/

hūm̐ a ha dzhaiṃ lan gsum brjod la gu gul sogs rdzas kyis bdug cing dril bu bsil/ rol chen sogs byas la/ ā be sha ya ā be sha ya/ stambha ya stambha ya/ ra ra ra ra/ tsa la ya tsa la ya hūm̐/ a ha dzhai/ zhes mang du brjod/ slar yang dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ khyed rang rnams kyi dpral bar zla ba'i steng du oṃ las 'khor lo oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ mgrin par padma'i steng du āḥlas padma āḥs mtshan pa/ snying khar nyi ma'i steng du aṃ las gri gug aṃ gis mtshan pa de rnams las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi phyag mtshan dang / rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma lha mo bco lnga'i sku'i rnam pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa byon nas khyed rang rnams kyi gnas gsum du thim pas/ sku gsung thugs kyi byin brlabs dang nus mthu ma lus pa zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces dang / phreng sngags ā li'i dbyangs su bzlas shing rol mo'i sgra bya/ de lta bu'i ye shes pa de nyid sku babs na 'phar ba dang g.yo ba/ gsung babs na rgod pa dang saṃskṛ ta'i skad smra ba la sogs pa/ thugs babs na rnam par mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin skye ba la sogs pa'i nyams myong gang skyes pa de nyid ma brjed par lam du bskyangs dgos so/ /de lta bu'i ye shes pa de khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor slob dpon gyis rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag pa'i sgo nas brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ tiṣṭha badzra ces brjod cing thams cad la tshar ba dang / de ltar ye shes phebs pa de lhag pa'i lha dang ngo sprod pa'i phyir du dkyil 'khor la gsol ba 'debs dgos pas zhes dang / slob dpon gyi langs te zhwa phud/ dril bsil dang bcas pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /bdag med ma dpal grong khyer mchog /snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni/ /bdag gi slob ma gzhug par bgyi/ /lha yi rigs kyi rim pa dang / /bsod nams rim pa'ang de bzhin shog

/rigs ni gang gi snod du 'gyur/ /'di la bsod nams ci yod pa/ /dkyil 'khor 'dir ni de bzhin shog /ces lan gsum brjod/ de ltar gsol ba btab pa la brten nas dkyil 'khor du 'jug par gnang ste dngos grub kyi bltas brtag pa'i ched du khyed rang rnams mig mig ras dang bcas bzhin pas dkyil 'khor gyi steng gi nam mkha' 'dom gang khor yug tsam la bltas pas mig lam du kha dog gi mthong snang ci byung de smras dgos pas/ kye khyed kyi mig lam na kha dog ci snang zhes dris la dkar po mthong na zhi ba/ ser pos rgyas pa/ dmar pos dbang / sngon po'am nag pos mngon spyod dam drag po/ ljang khu'am sna tshogs sam/ khra bor mthong na las sna tshogs pa 'grub par 'gyur ro zhes dngos grub kyi mtshan bltas brtag nas/ slob dpon gyis dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad gdan gsum tshang ba'i rang bzhin du shes pa'i ngang nas rdo rje thugs kha dang / dril bu chig brdungs du byed cing / zhe sdang rdo rje sogs kyis bstod la khyed rang rnams kyi phyag na yod pa'i me tog gi phreng ba rnams thogs te/ 'di na bcom ldan 'das rdo rje bdag med ma lha mo bco lnga'i rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor bzhugs pa'i gtso bo nas me ri'i bar ye shes kyi snang ba gcig las grub pa yin pas bzang ngan dang mchog dman med mod/ 'on kyang rang gis las 'brel bsags pa'i lha zhig la 'bab par shog snyam pas/ gtso bo'i dbu thog tu phul bar mos nas/ oṃ pra tītstsha badzra hoḥ zhes gsung zhing 'bul ba'i stang ka re mdzod/ /ces 'bul du bcug la slob dpon gyis phyag tu bzhes nas 'bul tshul tsam byed cing slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag la/ oṃ pra tī gṛhṇa satwaṃ i mam̐ satwa mahā ba la/ oṃ rdo rje bdag med deng khyod kyi/ /mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad/ /phye bas thams cad mthong 'gyur ba/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/

/nam̐ badzra nai rātma pā shya/ zhes brjod cing mig ras dkrol/ khyed rang rnams dkyil 'khor la legs par gzigs shig slar yang dkyil 'khor blta bar bskul ba ni/ thar pa chen po'i grong khyer mchog /ltos shig ltos shig sems dpa' che/ /me tog gang la lhung gyur pa/ /de ni khyod kyi bdag med ma/ /dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos/ /da ni dad pa rab tu bskyed/ /khyod kyang sangs rgyas rigs su skyes/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs/ /khyod ni rnal 'byor ma ris skyes/ /dam tshig thams cad bskyang ba dang / /sngags rnams la yang brtson par gyis/ /zhes dkyil 'khor blta bar bskul nas/ gang la blta ba'i dkyil 'khor ni rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma'i dkyil 'khor yin te/ de yang slob dpon gyis ngag tu brjod pa ltar/ khyed rang rnams kyis gsal lam ste gzigs pa'i mos pa mdzad nas/ thugs ma yengs par sems gtod pa zhu/ de yang phyi rol rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa ba/ drwa ba/ gur/ bla bre/ ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du/ dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dbus su sna tshogs rdo rje'i stegs bu la gnas pa'i thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang 'phar ma gnyis pa/ gru bzhi pa/ sgo bzhi pa/ nang nas rim pa bzhin nag po/ ljang khu/ dmar po/ ser po/ dkar po'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ de'i steng du rin po che'i pha gu ser po la/ drwa ba dang drwa ba phyed pa 'phyang ba/ de'i steng du rin po che'i mda' yab dang pu shus brgyan pa/ rtsig pa'i phyi rol du 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar po la mchod pa'i lha mo bcu drug gis mchod rdzas du ma thogs nas bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa/ nang ka ba brgyad dang ldan pa'i steng rdo rje'i gdung zlum po dang / de'i steng rdo rje'i gdung bzhis mig mangs ris su bres shing mdzes par phub pa/ dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i steng du rdo rje rin po che'i tog gis brgyan pa/

sgo bzhi'i thad sor ka ba bzhi bzhis bteg pa'i rta babs bang rim bzhi dang ldan pa'i steng du/ padma la gnas pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo dang / gdugs dang / ri dwags dang bcas pa/ gzhan yang gos dang / 'phan dang / me tog gi phreng ba dang / zla ba rlung gis bskyod pa dang / rnga yab nor bu'i yu ba can la sogs pa rgyan du mas brgyan pa'i gzhal yas khang dang / de'i phyir rol du dur khrod chen po brgyad/ de dag la gnas pa'i shing chen po brgyad/ shing gi rtsa ba la gnas pa'i phyogs skyong ba brgyad/ shing gi yal ga la gnas pa'i zhing skyong ba brgyad/ de dag gi nam mkha' la gnas pa'i sprin chen po brgyad/ de dag la gnas pa'i klu chen po brgyad/ gzhan yang ro mgo bo bcad pa dang / dpyangs ba dang / bsnyal ba dang / gsal shing gis phug pa dang / mgo bo dang / keng rus dang / ce spyang dang / khwa dang / 'ug pa dang / bya rgod dang / /ro lang rnams phaiṃ zhes bya ba'i sgra sgrogs par byed pa/ ma lus pa rnams kyang sngon gyi grub pa thob pa rnams kyi mngon par rtogs pa ste/ gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / sha za dang / smyo byed dang / brjed byed dang / mkha' 'gro dang / mkha' 'gro ma rnams dang / chu brgyad/ me brgyad/ mchod rten brgyad/ sgrub pa po rnams dang bcas pa'i dur khrod kyi yongs su bskor ba'i gzhal yas khang gi lha snam shar dkar/ lhor ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / dbus sngon po'i dbus su sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i mu khyud la rdo rje'i rwa ba dang / 'od zer phreng bas bskor ba'i dbus dang phyogs bzhir nyi ma dang / ro'i gdan re re/ phyi'i phyogs mtshams brgyad dang / gtso mo'i 'og dang steng rnams su padma dang nyi ma ro'i gdan re re ste/ rten gzhal yas khang pa dang / dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du rdo rje bdag med ma/ shar du rdo rje ma/ lhor gsang ba'i dkar mo/ nub tu chu'i rnal 'byor ma/ byang du rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/

phyi'i 'phar ma la/ byang shar du pukka sī/ shar lhor ri khrod ma/ lho nub tu gdol pa mo/ nub byang du g.yung mo/ shar du gau rī/ lhor tsau rī/ nub tu baitā lī/ byang du ghasma rī/ 'og tu sa spyod ma/ steng du mkha' spyod ma ste/ lha mo thams cad kyang sku mdog nag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ nu 'bur zung gis mdzes pa/ smin mtshams su khro gnyer bsdus pa/ cung zad 'dzum zhing mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje gri gug 'phyar te 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa bdud bzhi'i khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa thugs kar bsnams pa/ g.yon pa'i gru mor rdo rje'i kha ṭwaṃ ga la dril bu dang ba dan gyis mtshan pa 'dzin pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan lngas brgyan cing stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ zhabs g.yon pa'i mthil gyis ro'i steng du mnan zhing / skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa ste/ rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma lha mo bco lnga'i rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad snang la rang bzhin med pa me long nang gi gzugs brnyan ltar mngon sum du gsal lam ste mthong ba yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/ de lta bu'i dkyil 'khor mthong ba la dga' spro dpag tu med pa'i sgo nas slob dpon gyi zhabs la phyag btsal bar mos te 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor chen po yi/ /dkyil 'khor du ni bdag zhugs so/ /oṃ rnal 'byor dkyil 'khor chen po yi/ /dkyil 'khor de ring bdag gis mthong / /oṃ gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po yi/ /dkyil 'khor du ni bdag dbang bskur/ /sa ma ya hoḥhoḥhoḥ de rnams kyis lha dang skal ba mnyam pa'i ched du dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i chos 'khor dang bcas pa song nas/ zhugs nas mngon par dbang bskur ba la dbang bzhi yod pa las bum pa'i dbang yin zhing /

bum pa'i dbang la rdo rje slob dpon dang / slob ma gnyis las/ rdo rje slob ma'i dbang bskur zhu ba'i yon du dmigs te maṇḍal zhig 'bul bar zhu/ de ltar maṇḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gyi bar du mdzod/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ khyed rang rnams sngon 'gro byur bsal ba'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs khru do tsam spangs pa'i sar dbang stegs kyi dkyil 'khor rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang pa gru bzhi sgo bzhi/ rta babs bzhis mdzes pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su saiṅga chen po brgyad kyis btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri padma nyi ma ro'i gdan gyi steng du khyed rang rnams rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma'i sku can re rer gsal lam ste gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de'i steng du gdugs dkar po gser gyi yu ba can/ g.yas su rgyal mtshan/ g.yon du ba dan/ mtha' skor du mchod pa'i bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor de bzhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de la thog ma slob dpon gyis chu bzhi'i sbyang ba byed dgos pas/ zhabs bsil gyis zhabs dkrus pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ nī rī hūm̐ khaṃ swāhā/ zhes brjod cing phyag rgya bcas la mthar se gol tog cing / mchod g.yog pas bzed zhal du chu blug pa nam mkhar bteg nas g.yas su bskor zhing dbus kyi bzed zhal du blug zhabs bsil gyi snod kha phub la bzhag de bzhin du zhal bsil ba'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badzra nai wi dya hūm̐ khaṃ swāhā/ 'thor 'thung lus la gtor ba'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ sarba saṃ sho dha ni swāhā/ mchod yon phyag tu gtad pa'i mos pa mdzod/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥkhaṃ raṃ mahā arghaṃ pra tītstsha swāhā/ zhes phyag rgya dang chu bskor zhing snod kha phub la 'jog pa sogs thams cad la gong bzhin byed/

khyed rang rnams kyi tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa'i sa bon/ snying khar yi ge kaṃ nag po'i rnam par gnas pa sna'i sgor sdig pa rwa can gyi rnam par 'thon nas mdun gyi til la thim pa de nyid las kyi he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pas g.yas su ye shes kyi mes bsreg cing / g.yon du chos nyid kyi rgya mtshor dor ba'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badzrā ya/ badzra sa twa sya/ sarba pā paṃ da ha na swāhā/ zhes brjod cing mchod g.yog pas til lag pa gnyis su blug la/ g.yas pas g.yas dang / g.yon pas g.yon du/ gnyis ka mnyam pas g.yas g.yon du bskor la me dang chur dor ba lan gsum/ thugs rje'i chus kyang sbyangs ba byas pa'i mos pa mdzod ces dang / de bzhin lag mthil gnyis su chu blug ste gong bzhin bskor zhing / oṃ hūm̐ ḍa ḍi ta phaṭ/ lan gsum gyis me dang chu dor/ khyed rang rnams kyi byur dang skal ba ngan pa dang / bkra mi shis pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swāhā/ de nas mchod g.yog pas rnam rgyal bum pa bteg la/ slob dpon gyis dril bsil me tog 'thor ba dang bcas pas/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra/ /zhes sogs shlau ka gsum brjod/ khyer rang rnams spang bya mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rgyal nas/ bkra shis dang bde legs kyi dpal dam pa thob par gyur cig zhes shis pa brjod la/ de rnams kyi sgo nas sngon du 'gro ba byur bsal ba'i cho ga song ste/ dngos gzhi dbang bskur bar byed pa la rang nyid lhag pa'i lha'i rten la rig pa'i dbang lnga bskur ba dang / rdo rje 'chang chen po'i rten la sku gsung thugs byin gyis rlabs pa'i dbang rnams su yod pa las/ thog mar rig pa'i dbang lnga bskur ba la dbang don dag bya dag byed dam/ sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo 'phrod pa gal che bas/ de yang khyed rang rnams kyi phung po lnga dang / nyon mongs pa lnga sbyang gzhi/

de nyid rigs lnga dang ye shes lnga'i ngo bor byin gyis brlabs pa ni sbyong byed yin zhing / sbyong byed des sbyangs pa la brten nas rigs lnga dang ye shes lnga mngon du gyur pa ni sbyangs 'bras yin pas rig pa'i dbang lnga po re re la'ang 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa bzhis byin gyis brlabs pa'am/ yang na mi bskyod pa la 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa bzhis byin gyis brlabs nas/ rin chen 'byung ldan man la slob dpon mi bskyod pa'i nga rgyal kho nas gnas par byas la/ slob ma dang dbang rdzas go 'pho ba phyag len yin pas/ mi bskyod pa chu'i dbang gi don du las bum gyi chu slob dpon slob ma dbang rdzas gsum ka la gtor zhing / oṃ swa bhā wa shuddha sarba dharma swa bha wa shuddho3haṃ/ khyed rang rnams kyi rnam par shes pa'i phung po dang dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu/ rdo rje slob dpon dang bcas pa mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las padma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ gsum ka'ang mi bskyod pa sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rdo rje g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum mā mā ki sngon mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma/ rna bar zhe sdang rdo rje ma/ sna la ser sna rdo rje ma/ kha la 'dod chags rdo rje ma/ lus la phrag dog rdo rje ma/ yid la bdag med rnal 'byor ma/ spyi bor sku rdo rje ma/ mgrin par gsung rdo rje ma/ thugs kar thugs rdo rje ma/ slob dpon gyi thugs kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mi bskyod pa yab yum gyi rnam par oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes phyag rgya dang bcas pas spyan drangs/
