rnam par snang mdzad ming gi dbang gi don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ bum chu mthor tshul dang swa bhā wa 'dra/ khyed rang rnams kyi phung po mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las padma dang / ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bhrum̐ las 'khor lo bhrum̐ gyi mtshan pa de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ khyed rang rnams rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas 'khor lo dang g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum sangs rgyas spyan ma dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma sogs gong bzhin/ slob dpon gyi thugs kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rnam par snang mdzad yab yum gyi rnam par oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ gau rī sogs dang / khyed rang rnams la gnyis su med par thim/ 'dir dbang rdzas bsgrub pa med pas/ khyed rang rnams dbang gi don du gsol ba btab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ de bzhin gshegs pa sogs brjod/ zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lha slob dpon dang bcas pas ming gi dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badzra satwa satwaṃ a bhi ṣiñtsā mi badzra nā ma a bhi ṣe ka ta zhes brjod cing slob dpon gyi lag pa g.yas pas rdor dril gnyis ka lhan cig tu dkrol zhing / khyed rang rnams la sngar nas gsang mtshan yod na des tshangs/ med pa dang brjed pa la sogs pa yin na 'di'i skabs su gdags dgos pa yin pas zhes brda sprad la/ slob ma re re'i mdun du dril bu dkrol zhing kyai zhes dris la/ yod pa rnams la de khas 'thus/ gzhan brjed pa rnams la'ang 'dogs dgos byung na/ dpal kyai rdo rje zhes bya ba lta bu la sogs pa gdags par bya'o/ /dbang 'di brtan pa'i yan lag tu sogs gong bzhin las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan ces brjod/

khyed rang rnams rnam par snang mdzad kyi rang bzhin du gnas pa la sogs mchod pa lngas mchod/ de ltar na rnam par snang mdzad kyi sgo nas ming gi dbang bskur ba thob/ gti mug dag gzugs kyi phung po gnas gyur/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi bag chags dang sa bon ma lus pa rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ /dbang de rnams kyi don ni/ dngos kun gang dang gang snang ba/ /gtso de rang gi lhag pa'i lha/ /chos rnams rang bzhin snyog med dag /sangs rgyas ye shes blta bar gyis/ /de'i don rnams bsam par bya'o/ /de nas rdo rje 'chang chen po'i rten la sku gsum du byin gyis rlobs par byed pa brtul zhugs kyi dbang bskur ba'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ bum chu mthor mi dgos/ swa bhā wa sogs gong bzhin/ khyed rang rnams kyi phung po lnga'i chos nyid la/ tha mal du 'dzin pa'i rnam rtogs mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las padma dang / ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'dus yongs su gyur pa las khyed rang rnams kyi phung po lnga'i chos nyid rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rdo rje snyems ma dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma sogs gong bzhin/ slob dpon gyi thugs kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum gyi rnam par oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ gau rī sogs gong bzhin/ khyed rang rnams la gnyis su med par thim/ slob dpon gyis a bhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ sarba ta thā ga ta zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis oṃ badzrī bum chu mi 'thor/

bhā wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu rgyan/ khyed rang rnams rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin du gnas pa la hūm̐ dang / gser sogs las grub pa'i rdo rje tshad dang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa lha nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi rang bzhin du gyur pa re khyed rang rnams kyi phyag g.yas par brtul zhugs kyi dbang gi don du sbyin pa'i mos pa mdzod/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad ste/ /rdo rje sems dpa' phyag na gnas/ /khyod kyi kyang ni rtag tu bzung / /phyag na rdo rje brtul zhugs brtan/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta siddhi badzra sa ma ya tiṣṭha e ṣa twaṃ dhā ra yā mi badzra satwa hi hi hi hi hūm̐/ zhes sbyin pas rdo rje de gsor te khyed rang rnams kyi snying khar bzung nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa lnga bo thams cad kyi bdag nyid nga yin no snyam du bsam/ de ltar thun mong ba rig pa'i dbang lnga dang / rdo rje brtul zhugs dang bcas pa de rnams kyis rdo rje slob ma'i dbang bskur ba song nas/ thun mong ma yin pa rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang zhu pa'i yon du dmigs te maṇḍal zhig 'bul bar zhu/ de ltar maṇḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gyi bar du mdzod/ mi ldog 'khor lo'i dbang bskur ba/ /mgon pos bdag la stsal nas kyang / /'khor lo lha yi de nyid dang / /slob dpon 'phrin las yongs su bzung / /sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig dang / /sdom pa'ang bla na med pa stsol/ /de ltar gsol ba btab nas khyed rang rnams gong du bshad pa'i dbang stegs kyi steng du/ da lta bskyed ma thag pa'i rdo rje sems dpa'i nga rgyal gyis 'khod pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nyid la dam tshig gsum rim gyis sbyin dgos pa las/ thog mar rdo rje thugs kyi dam tshig tu/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje mtshan nyid dang ldan pa lha nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi rang bzhin khyed rang rnams kyi phyag g.yas su sbyin pa'i mos pa mdzod/

'di de sogs sngags dang bcas pas/ slob ma rnams kyi lag pa g.yas par gtad tshar ba dang / de ltar sbyin pa'i rdo rje de nyid gsor te thugs kar sku 'gying bag dang bcas pas bzung nas/ rdo rje'i de kho na nyid brjod pa 'di la gsan pas khyab par gda' ste/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje snyems ma'i bdag pos bdag /bcom ldan 'das dpal mchog dang po'i skyes bu la'o/ /oṃ mahā badzra hūm̐/ de'i don ni 'di yin te/ rdo rje 'di ni chos thams cad kyi dbyings spros pa dang bral ba rig stong dbyer med kyi ngo bo mtshon par byed pa yin/ rang gi sems thog ma dang tha ma med pa'i byang chub kyi sems spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba nges don gyi rdo rje yin no snyam du mos pa mdzod/ dril bu gsung gi dam tshig gi don du a dang mkhar ba sogs las byung ba'i dril bu tshad dang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ lha nyi shu rtsa gsum gyi rang bzhin re khyed rang rnams kyi phyag g.yon du byin pa'i mos pa mdzod/ 'di ni rnal 'byor ma kun gyi/ /shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bzung / /byang chub mchog tu rgyal bas bzhed/ /ces slob ma rnams kyi lag pa g.yon du gtad tshar ba dang / de ltar sbyin pa'i dril bu de nyid g.yon par kha gyen du gtad nas bzung ste/ dril bu'i de kho na nyid brjod pa 'di la gsan pas khyab par gda' ste/ /a/ srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems ldan pa/ /srid pa dam pa byed par 'gyur/ /oṃ badzra ghaṇṭe āḥ de'i don ni 'di yin te/ dril bu 'di ni chos thams cad kyi dbyings spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba skye 'gag gnas gsum gyis stong pa mtshon par byed pa yin/ rang gi ngag srid pa thams cad kyi rang bzhin rnam par dag pa ston par byed pa'i nges don gyi dril bu yin no snyam du mos pa mdzod/

de nas phyag rgya chen po sku'i dam tshig gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ khyed rang rnams skad cig gi rdo rje 'chang chen po sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje snyems ma sku mdog dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i sku can du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de'i mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma sogs gong bzhin brjod/ slob dpon gyi thugs kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rdo rje 'chang chen po yab yum gyi rnam par oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ khyed rang rnams la gnyis su med par thim pa'i mos pa mdzad nas/ phyag gnyis thugs khar 'khyud pa'i stang kha yang mdzad par zhu shes rab bcu drug lon pa la/ /lag pa dag gis yang dag 'khyud/ /rdo rje dril bu mnyam sbyor ba/ /slob dpon gyis ni dbang du brjod/ /rdo rje che dang dril bu che/ /bzung shig rdo rjer byin gyis rlobs/ /de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur/ /slob ma'i tshogs rnams bsdu bar gyis/ /srid pa'i bde ba shin tu chung / /sdug bsngal chen po dag bya'i phyir/ /shin tu bde ba dam pa'i thabs/ /dam tshig 'di ni khyod kyis long / /'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad la/ /ci 'dod pa ni bsten bzhin du/ /rang gi lhag pa'i lha sbyor bas/ /bdag dang gzhan la mchod par gyis/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis/ /'da' ba ru ni mi mdzad pa'i/ /phyag rgya'i dam tshig zhes su bshad/ /yid kyi lus ni brtan phyir ro/ /de'i don ni 'di yin te/ tha mal pa'i bde ba ni ma dag pa'o/ /srid pa'i sdug bsngal zad par bya ba'i phyir rang gi lhag pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor la gnas par bya ste/ 'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad la longs spyod cig thams cad la mchod par gyis shig 'dis rdo rje 'chang chen po kha sbyor yan lag bdun ldan gyi sku thob pa las mi 'da'o/

/de bas na ting nge 'dzin 'di la gnas par gyis shig ces pa'i don yin pas/ 'og tu mchod pa rgyas pas mchod pa ma byung gi bar du phyag rgya dang ting nge 'dzin de nyid dang ma bral bar mdzad dgos so/ dbang de rnams brtan pa'i yan lag tu/ bum pa'i chus kyang spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ sangs rgyas rnams ni slob ma'i spyi bor bum chu gtor/ thams cad kyi/ /sogs sngags dang bcas pa brjod/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rdo rje 'chang chen po re res dbur brgyan pa'i mos pa mdzod/ dbang gi lha thams cad dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ khyed rang rnams la gnyis su med par thim ste/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis khyed rang rnams la khams gsum chos kyi rgyal por dbang bskur zhing rab tu gnas pa de nyid la slob dpon gyis kyang rab tu gnas pas brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swāhā/ zhes brjod cing slob ma re re'i spyi bor me tog gtor la/ de ltar na khyed rang rnams rdo rje 'chang chen po'i rang bzhin du gnas pa la/ slob dpon gyis mchod pa rgyas pas mchod pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badzra puṣpe sogs brjod la/ mchod g.yog pas mchod pa bskor zhing gang bder bsdu'o/ /de rnams kyi rdo rje slob dpon gyis dbang gi dngos gzhi song nas/ de'i rjes su dbang bskur nas ni de nyid bstan/ zhes 'byung bas dkyil 'khor gyi de kho na nyid ston pa 'di la gsan pas khyab par gda' ste/ de ltar na khyed la rdo rje 'chang chen po'i dbang bskur ba 'dis khyod kyi phung po dang / khams dang / skye mched kyi dri ma thams cad dag par byas pa yin pas de thams cad rang gi sems su 'du la/ sems de nyid mi bskyod pa'i rang bzhin rdo rje sems dpa' yin pas rang gi sems rnam par dag pa nyid dkyil 'khor kyi 'khor lo yin te/

gzhal yas khang pa ni byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun gyi ngo bo yin la/ de yang rang gi sems rnam par dag pa'o/ /zhes rten gyi dag pa dang / gzugs phung rdo rje ma yin te/ /tshor ba la yang dkar mor brjod/ /'du shes chu yi rnal 'byor ma/ /'du byed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /rnam shes phung po'i tshul gyis ni/ /bdag med rnal 'byor ma gnas so/ /zhe sdang zhes bshad rdo rje ma/ /'dod chags chu yis rnal 'byor ma/ /phrag dog rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /ser sna gsang ba'i dkar mo nyid/ /gti mug de bzhin rdo rjer bshad/ /sa ni pukka sī zhes bshad/ /chu khams rngon pa mo zhes bshad/ /me ni gtum mor shes par bya/ /rlung ni g.yung mo rab tu grags/ /gzugs la gau rīr rtag tu bshad/ /sgra la chom rkun mar rab grags/ /dri yi cha la ro lang ma/ /ro la ghasma ri rab grags/ /reg la sa spyod ma zhes brjod/ /chos kyi dbyings la mkha' spyod ma/ /zhes lha'i rnam dag dang / mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma/ /rna bar zhe sdang rdo rje ma/ /sna la ser sna rdo rje ma/ /kha la 'dod chags rdo rje ma/ /lus la phrag dog rdo rje ma/ /yid la bdag med rnal 'byor ma/ /zhes dbang po'i rnam dag dang / nga rgyal la sogs skyon drug rnams/ /gcod phyir gri gug rnam par 'dzin/ /dngos dang dngos med rnam rtog gi /mgo bo padma'i snod du ni/ /bdud rnams rnam pa bzhi yi khrag /dngos grub phyir ni btung bar bya/ /stong pa'i rnam pas kha ṭwāṃ ga /thabs kyi ro ni rnam par brtag /zhes phyag mtshan gyi dag pa dang / spyi bo'i 'khor lo mi bskyod pa/ /rna cha'i bdag nyid 'od dpag med/ /mgul gyi phreng ba rin chen bdag /lag par rnam par snang mdzad brjod/ /ska rags la ni don yod gnas/ /yan lag kun la rdor 'dzin mgon/ /zhes rgyan cha'i dag pa rnams dran par bya'o/ /de bas na sems nyid ni byang phyogs so bdun gyi ngo bo gzhal yas khang pa yin la/

sems la'ang phung po khams dang skye mched la sogs pa du mar snang ba ni gdan gsum tshang ba'i lha yin te/ de yang phung po lnga ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i gdan/ 'byung ba bzhi ni rig ma'i gdan/ nang gi skye mched ni byang chub sems dpa'i gdan/ phyi'i skye mched ni lha mo'i gdan/ nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa la sogs pa zad par byed pa ni khro bo dang khro mo'i gdan yin no/ de ltar de kho na nyid rtogs pa'i slob ma la rjes su gnang ba sbyin dgos pas/ de la thog mar lha mchod pa rjes su gnang ba'i don du khyed rang rnams gar bskor sngon du 'gro bas rdo rje khu tshur gnyis sku g.yas g.yon du bzhag pa la sogs pa'i phyag rgya 'di rnams mdzad par zhu zhig ces brda sprad la slob dpon gyis/ deng nas brtsams te rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /sras dang bcas la rnam rol zhing / /rdo rje snyems ma'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /dga' ston bde ba'i mchod pa gyis/ /āḥ/ de bzhin du khu tshur 'gram pa g.yas g.yon du bzhag ste/ sangs rgyas thams cad mchod par bya/ /des ni bcom ldan 'bral mi 'gyur/ /phreng ba de yi rgyan yin no/ /oṃ/ khu tshur gnyis kha nas 'byin pa ltar byas te/ lus can kun la dam chos kyi/ /glu ni khyod kyis blang bar bya/ /de yis bde gshegs dngos grub ni/ /myur du bde ba myong bar 'gyur/ /gī/ /rdo rje thal mo spyi bor bskor ba'i gar byas te/ /de nyid thal mo'i gar gyis ni/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mchod par bya/ /sangs rgyas 'du ba'i 'phrin las kyis/ /gar mkhan tshul du bsgyur bar gyis/ /hoḥ/ khu tshur gnyis bdug spos kyi phyag rgya dang / /rdzogs sangs rgyas la spos phul bas/ /brtul zhugs bzang pos legs tshim gyis/ /lus can bde gshegs cha lugs su/ /ye shes kyis ni tshim par gyis/ /hūm̐/ me tog gi phyag rgya dang / sangs rgyas rnams la me tog gtor/ /byang chub yan lag tshogs gyur pas/

/mtshan dang dpe byad ldan pa yi/ /bde gshegs sku ni thob par gyis/ /bhrūm̐/ mar me'i phyag rgya dang / chos kyi me ni legs sbar bas/ /rdo rje chos dang 'dra ba ru/ /sems can ma rig ldong pa la/ /ye shes sgron me gsal bar gyis/ /pra/ g.yon pas dung chos 'dzin cing / g.yas pas dri bzang byugs pa'i tshul dang / rgyal ba rnams la dri phul bas/ /tshul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab dang / /rnam grol ye shes mthong ba yis/ /byang chub lus can rnams la bgos/ /ghāḥ de ltar na phyag rgya de rnams bcas pa la brten nas/ deng phyin chad lus kyi sgo nas sgeg pa dang / ngag gi sgo nas glu len pa la sogs pa spyod lam ci byed pa thams cad mi dge ba dang / lung ma bstan ma yin par lha mchod pas bsam pa'i zin par gyis shig de ltar byas pas las ci byas pa thams cad dge bar 'gyur ba'i bsod nams chen po thob pa yin no/ /phyag rgya rnams dpon slob gnyis kas 'cha'/ sems can don byed kyi rjes su gnang ba la mi shes pa'i mig gi rab rib bsal dgos pas mig thur ram/ rdo rje byin gyis brlabs pa'i phyir rtsa ba'i sngags aṣṭa tshar gcig bzlas pas mngon par bsngags pa'i mig thur praṃ las byung ba'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma'i rang bzhin can gyi thur mar gyur pa de nyid ces bsam/ mig thur med na hūm̐ las byung ba'i ye shes kyi rdo rjer gyur pa de nyid kyi mig gi thad kar dbyugs pa la brten nas/ mi shes pa'i mig gi rab rib kyi ling thog bsal nas sems can gyi don la 'jug pa'i mthu dang ldan par byas pa yin snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod/ thur mas mig 'byed pa'i tshul bya zhing / ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis/ /'jig rten ling tog bsal ba ltar/ /bu khyod kyi ni mi shes pa'i/ /ling tog rgyal ba rnams kyis bsal/ /oṃ badzra nai tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa laṃ pa hrīḥpraṃ/ de ltar mi shes pa'i mig gi rab rib bsal te sems can gyi don la 'jug pa'i mthu dang ldan par byas nas chos thams cad snang la rang bzhin med pa me long nang gi gzugs brnyan ltar shes par gyis shig

ces a las skyes pa'i me long slob ma la bstan cing bskor la/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ /bzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun tu 'byung / /ngo bo nyid med gnas med pa/ /de ltar chos rnams shes gyis la/ /sems can don ni mnyam med byos/ /'on kyang skyob pa'i sras su skye/ /de ltar na chos thams cad snang la rang bzhin med pa me long nang gi gzugs brnyan ltar shes par ma zad/ sgra thams cad brag stong dril bu'i sgra ltar shes dgos so/ /zhes a las skyes pa'i dril bu dkrol zhing / a thams cad nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de/ /nam mkha' la ni mtshan nyid med/ /nam mkha' dang ni mnyam sbyor bas/ /kun mchog mnyam pa nyid du gsal/ /chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong pa nyid du shes par byas nas/ gnas lugs rtogs pa'i shes rab dang ldan yang / thabs mkhas kyi khyad par dang bral na nyan rang gis sar lhung bar 'gyur bas rang don yid byed kyi bsam pa sbyong dgos so zhes pa'i ched du/ hoḥlas byung ba'i thabs kyi gzhu dang / shes rab kyi mda' drug dang bcas pa byin pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod cing mda' gzhu gtad la/ slob dpon gyi hoḥ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang rjes su chags par byos shig ces brjod pa dang / slob mas mda' gzhu 'gengs pa'i tshul byas nas phyogs bzhi steng 'og gnyis te gnas drug tu 'phangs pas rang don yid byed kyi bsam pa bcom pa'i mos pa byas la/ hoḥde bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang rjes su chags par bya'o/ /zhes gsung dgos so/ /zhes brda sbyar la/ mda' 'phen pa'i stangs ka tsam byed du bzhugs/ de ltar khyed rnams kyi chos thams cad snang la rang bzhin med pa me long nang gi gzugs brnyan ltar shes shing / sgra thams cad grag stong du shes pa dang / rang don yid byed kyi bsam pa bcom zin yang / gzhan don mi nus so snyam na shin tu nus pa ste ye shes dbab pa'i dus su dbang gi ye shes rdo rje sems dpa' khyed rang rnams kyi snying dkyil du zhugs pa yin no zhes shes pa'i ched du me long gi rjes gnang gnyis pa yin te/

me long rdo rje dang bcas pa slob ma rnams la bstan te bskor la/ nam nai rātma/ bdag med ma dpal me long ltar/ /gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ /bu khyod kyi ni snying la zhugs/ /bdag med ma yi rang bzhin gtso/ /gang yang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bdag po byang chub kyi sems ni 'di yin par shes par gyis shig de nas chos bshad pa'i rjes su gnang ba'i don du oṃ badzra he tu maṃ zhes pa sems can 'khor ba las drongs shig ces pa'i don yin pas ces brjod cing 'khor lo bris pa'am bzos pa slob ma rnams kyi mdun du slob dpon gyis bzhag mchod g.yog pas rim pa bzhin drud/ 'dren lugs ji ltar byed na/ oṃ badzra bhā ṣa ram̐ zhes pas phyag g.yas su dung byin te de bus nas sems can 'khor du bsdus shig ces pa'i don yin tshul ji ltar na/ oṃ badzra ghaṇḍe a/ zhes phyag g.yon du dril bu byin te chos kyi sgra sgrogs zhes pa'i don yin/ chos gang gis na de gnyis kyi bar du rgyud kyi glegs bam byin te chos 'di'i sgra sgrogs par gyis shig ces pa'i don yin pas de ltar nges pa'i sgo nas dung 'bud pa dang dril bu dkrol tsam dang / glegs bam klog pa'i tshul mdzod cig ces brjod la slob ma re re la sngags rnams brjod cing / 'khor lo la sogs gtad tshar ba dang / de'i don 'di la gsan pas khyab par gda'/ deng nas brtsams te sems bskyed pa/ /tsam gyis chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /khyod kyis the tshom dogs med pa/ /yid gnyis med pa'i sems kyis su/ /chos kyi dung ni bla med pa/ /dri med kun tu gang bar gyis/ /sngags spyod tshul gyi cho ga yis/ /skye bo rnams la rtag tu shod/ /de ltar byas na sangs rgyas la/ /phan thogs drin du bzo zhes bya/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa de kun yang / /khyed la brtag tu bsrung bar mdzad/ /de ltar chos bshad pa'i rjes su gnang ba byin nas/ chos bshad pa de yang de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga dang 'brel ba'i rdo rje theg pa'i chos bstan dgos so zhes shes pa'i ched du rigs lnga'i sprul bshad kyi rjes su gnang pa ni/

rigs lnga so so'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas phyag rgya 'di rnams mdzad pa zhu/ dpon slob gnyis kas gar bskor sngon du 'gro bas rigs lnga so so'i phyag chen rnams rim pa bzhin bcas la/ slob dpon gyis/ sems can kun la thams cad du/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul 'gyur ba'i/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /zhes rnam snang dang / de bzhin du tshig rkang dang po gsum 'dra ba las/ 'khor lo'i tshab tu/ rdo rje'i 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /zhes mi bskyod pa dang / rin chen 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /zhes rin 'byung / padma'i 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /zhes 'od dpag med/ sna tshogs 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /zhes don yod grub pa'i phyag rgya rnams tshar mtshams de ltar na khyod kyis sems thams cad la chos kyi 'khor lo/ rdo rje'i 'khor lo/ rin chen 'khor lo/ padma'i 'khor lo/ sna tshogs 'khor lo rnams bskor la chos kyi dung bus/ sgra sgrogs/ bshad pa gyis shig ces pa'i don yin/ de ltar na bskyed pa rdul tshon nam/ ras bris kyis sogs skabs dang sbyar la dkyil 'khor du bum pa'i dbang thob/ gtso bor lus kyi dri ma dag dam tshig rtsa ba dang yan lag gi lam bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu sprul ba'i sku'i bag chags dang sa bon ma lus pa rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ /zhes rtogs pa bskyed pa rnams kyis rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang bskur ba song nas/ bla ma gsung rdo rje longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i bdag nyid can la gsang dbang zhu ba'i yon du dmigs te maṇḍal zhig 'bul bar zhu/ de ltar maṇḍal phul nas bstod pa dang gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs yongs su bskor/ /khyod ni nyid kyis thugs kyi mchog brnyes pa/ /khyod kyi rgyu dang mi rgyu'i 'gro ba kun brgyan te/ /snying rje'i thugs kyi sems can sad mdzad pa/

/sgyu ma'i spros pa rdo rje bsgrub pa'i yid/ /he ru ka dpal rdo rje yid kyi dges/ /tshar cig bcom ldan zhi ba chen po kye/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor gcig bzhed pa/ /mi phyed phyag rgya bsgrub pa po/ /rdo rje sbyor las yang dag byung / /ji ltar khyod ni bdag nyid che/ /mnga' bdag bdag la'ang de ltar mdzod/ /'khor ba 'dam gyi tshogs nang du/ /bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyobs/ /zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab nas/ khyed rang rnams kyi sngon chad kun rdzob byang chub kyi dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba'i brdar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing mig ras rnams 'ching bar zhu/ bla ma he ru ka yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs/ yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs khar rjes su chags pa'i mes 'od du zhu/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi khar babs pa'i byang chub kyi sems kyi thig le dung dang kunda ltar dkar ba slob dpon gyis mtheb srin gyis blang ste khyed rang rnams kyi lce thog tu bzhag pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bdud rtsi ril bu btab pa'i nang mchod nas byin zhing / ji ltar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /byang chub sras rnams dbang bskur ltar/ /bdag gi gsang ba'i dbang gis ni/ /sems kyi rgyun gyis dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes sbyin pa de nyid khyed rang rnams kyis a hoḥmahā su kha hoḥ zhes mgrin par myangs pa la brten nas/ mgrin pa na gzhir gnas kyi rtsa ya ra la wa zhes pa'i yi ge 'bru bzhi'i rnam par gnas pa la thim pas/ de nas rim gyis brgyud de lus kyi rtsa gnas thams cad la khyab pas rang bzhin brgyad bcu'i rnam par rtog pa thams cad 'gags nas rang byung gi ye shes gsal stong bde bas brgyan pa'i ting nge 'dzin khyad par can rgyud la skyes pa'i mos pa mdzad nas de'i ngang la cung zad mnyam par 'jog par zhu/

de dbang gi dngos gzhi yin/ dbang de thob pa'i brdar oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes gsungs shing gdong ras rnams 'grol bar zhu/ de'i mtha' rten du lung bstan dgos pas lung bstan phal cher sprul skus ston pas/ 'dir yang slob dpon sprul pa'i sku shākya thub pa'i nga rgyal du 'phos nas lag pa g.yon pas chos gos kyi grwa gnyis seṅge'i rna ba ltar byas te/ g.yas rdo dril lhan cig tu bzung nas skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgyas/ khyed rnams ma 'ongs pa na gsang mtshan dang mthun pa'i sangs rgyas 'di dang 'di lta bur 'gyur ro/ /zhes lung ston pa yin te/ 'dir ni khyod la ngas lung bstan/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /srid pa shin tu dag pas na/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las ston/ /kyai zhes dris la slob ma rnams kyi dpal kyai rdo rje zhes pa lta bu gsang mtshan rnams brjod/ slob dpon gyis gsang mtshan gang smras byung ba bzhin brjod de/ /zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa sa 'og sa steng sa bla rnams su bhur bhu waḥswaḥgang la ngas lung bstan pa 'di la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang / dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo dang bcas pas mgrin gcig du lung ston par mdzad de sngags 'di dang phyag rgya 'di'i mthu yin no/ /zhes brjod/ de ltar na kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du gsang pa'i dbang thob/ gtso bor ngag gi dri ma dag dam tshig sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga'i ril bu brten pa la dbang / brda' mtheb srin e la rig byed gcig lam bdag byin gyis brlabs pa'i rim pa bsgom pa la dbang 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i bag chags dang sa bon ma lus pa rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ /zhes rtogs pa bskyed pa rnams kyis gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba song nas/ bla ma thugs rdo rje chos kyi sku'i bdag nyid can la shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal zhig 'bul bar zhu/

de ltar maṇḍal phul nas bstod pa dang gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs zhes dang / bcom ldan zhi ba chen po kye/ /sogs gong bzhin byas la/ khyed rang rnams sngon chad phyag rgya bha ga'i dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba'i brdar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes gsungs shing mig ras rnams 'ching bar zhu/ slob dpon kyai rdo rje gsal ba'i thugs kha nas rig ma lo bcu drug lon pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa re khyed rang rnams la gtad pa'i mos pa mdzod/ dga' ster gnas ster lha mo ni/ /sna tshogs gzugs can yid 'ong ma/ /khyer cig khyer cig sems dpa' che/ /khyer la mchod pa dag tu gyis/ /zhes pa'i sgo nas byin pa'i phyag rgya des/ khyed rang rnams gsang ba'i kun tu spyod pa'i snod dang ldan mi ldan brtag pa'i phyir dri ba byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bshang gci dag ni za ba dang / /khrag dang khu ba de bzhin te/ /sha chen bsten pa bu spro'am/ /bud med rnams la rtag gus dang / /bha ga'i padmor 'o byed pa/ /khyod ni ci dgar spro gyur tam/ /zhes dris pas/ de ltar spro'o zhes lan btab par mos nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bshang gci dag ni za ba dang / /khrag dang khu ba de bzhin te/ /sha chen bsten par cis mi spro/ /bud med rnams la rtag gus dang / /bha ga'i padmor 'o byed par/ /bdag nyid ci dgar spro gyur to/ /zhes lan btab pas/ phyag rgya de dgyes nas lus nam mkha'i gos can du byas/ gur gum la sogs dri bzang po'i chus byugs/ chu skyes rtsa mdzes pa'i bha ga bstan te padma'i che ba brjod pa yin te/ e ma nga yi padma 'di/ /bde ba thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /gal te cho ga bzhin bsten na/ /de yi mdun na nga 'dug ste/ /sangs rgyas bsnyen pa la sogs pa/ /padmar bya ba ji bzhin byed/ /bde chen rgyal po rang nyid de/ /'di nyid du ni rtag tu zhugs/ /blun po gang zhig 'di spong ba/

/de la mchog gi dngos grub med/ /satwaṃ padma bhañdza mokṣaḥhoḥ zhes gsung zhing khyed rang rnams kyi pang du byon pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas khyed rang rnams bcom ldan 'das kyai rdo rje yab yum du gsal ba sprul sku lam du byed pa lha'i 'du shes/ yum gyi mkha' mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las a las padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa ze'u 'bru la ā yis mtshan pa/ oṃ padma su khā dhā ra/ mahā rā ga su khaṃ mahā rā ga sunda tsa turā/ a nanda bha ga bi shwa/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ karya ku ru ṣwa me/ yab kyi gsang ba'i gnas mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ oṃ badzra ma hā dāe ṣa/ tsa tu ra/ ā nanda dā ya kāḥ kha ga mu kha e kā ra so nā tha/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ karyaṃ ku ru ṣwa me/ zhes pas mkha' gsang bsnol mar byin gyis brlabs pa longs sku lam du byed pa ngag sngags kyi 'du shes/ thabs 'di la brten nas bde chen lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mngon du bya'o snyam pa yid chos sku lam du byed pa chos kyi 'du shes/ 'du shes gsum dang ma bral ba'i sgo nas thog mar phyag rgya'i gzugs la lta ba/ sgra la snyan pa/ dri la bsnams pa/ ma mchu'i sbrang rtsi 'jib pa/ 'o dang / mkhyud pa dang / tsumba la sogs pa skad gcig dang po la dga' ba'i ye shes/ bo la dang kakko la sbyar ba la brten nas skad cig gnyis pa la mchog dga'i ye shes/ bsrub cing bsrub pa'i sbyor ba la brten nas skad cig gsum pa la dga' bral gyi dga' ba'i ye shes/ snyoms 'jug byas pa la brten nas skad gcig bzhi pa la lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mngon du byas pa yin snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de dag ni phyi go rim la ltos pa'i dga' ba yin/ nang gnas la ltos pa'i dga' ba bzhi ni/ de ltar snyoms par zhugs pa'i rjes chags kyi mes khams dwangs ma thams cad zhu nas/ spyi bo'i haṃ la 'dus te byang chub kyi sems de nyid spyi bo nas mgrin par babs pa'i dga' ba'i ye shes mgrin pa nas snying khar babs pas mchog dga'i ye shes/

snying kha nas lte bar babs pas dga' bral gyi dga' ba'i ye shes/ lte ba nas gsang gnas su babs nas rdo rje nor bu'i rtse mo mthar thug pa'i bar du byon te thig le dkar dmar gnyis ba thag tsam yang ma 'dzag par ri snar smug pa brgyug pa'am/ rtsa rtser zil pa chags pa bzhin reg la ma 'byar ba'i tshul gyis gnas pa'i dus su lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mngon du byas snyam par mos nas cung zad cig mnyam par 'jog par zhu/ de yas babs kyi dga' ba bzhi yin/ mas brtan gyi dga' ba bzhi bsgrub pa'i don du hūm̐ zhes gdangs dang bcas pas rlung 'pho ba med pa'i stobs kyi thig le dkar dmar so so'i rtsa gnas nas yar drangs lte ba'i rtsa 'khor thams cad khrig mer gyis gang bas dga' ba/ hūm̐ zhes yar drangs/ snying kha'i rtsa 'khor gang bas mchog dga'/ hūm̐ zhes yar drangs mgrin pa'i rtsa 'khor gang bas dga' bral gyi dga' ba/ hūm̐ zhes yar drangs spyi bo'i rtsa 'khor gang bas lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ byang chub kyi sems de nyid rlung dang 'khrul 'khor la sogs pas lus thams cad la khyab par dgram pas lus thams cad la rtsas khyab/ rtsa thams cad la byang chub sems kyis khyab/ de thams cad la mi rtog pas khyab ste bde stong zung 'jug rnam par mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin khyad par can rgyud la skyes pa'i mos pa mdzad nas/ de'i ngang du cung zad tsam zhig mnyam par 'jog par zhu/ de dbang gi dngos gzhi yin/ dbang de thob pa'i brdar oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing gdong ras rnams 'grol bar zhu/ de'i mtha' rten du lam gyi dbugs dbyung ba dang / 'bras bu'i dbugs dbyung ba gnyis las/ dang po lam gyi dbugs dbyung pa ni/ slob dpon smad par mi bya zhing / bde gshegs bka' las 'da' mi bya/ /spun la smad pa nyid mi bya/ /sems can rnams la sdug byams dang / /byang chub sems ni spangs mi bya/ /bdag gzhan chos la smad mi bya/

/skal med de nyid gtam mi bya/ /bdag gi lus la nges mi smad/ /chos la yid gnyis spang bya zhing / /gdug la byams pa nyid mi bya/ /chos nyid tshad ni bzung mi bya/ /skal ldan sems can spangs mi bya/ /dam tshig rtag tu bskyang bar bya/ /bud med nyid la smad mi bya/ /ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ /dkon mchog gsum ni spang mi bya/ /rtag tu dam tshig bsrung bar bya/ /rdo rje dril bu bzung bar bya/ /gtsug tor rtag tu bcang bar bya/ /rtag tu sbyin bsreg dgang bar bya/ /rtag tu dkyil 'khor bzhengs par bya/ /rtag tu bde gshegs rab gnas bya/ /'byung po che la gtor ma sbyin/ /phyag rgya 'ching ba rnams spangs shing / /mchod rten las ni mi bya ste/ /rdo rje gsum mchog phyag mi bya/ /dkyil 'khor la sogs lus kyi las/ /rmi lam du yang mi bya 'o/ /slob dpon gzhan la phyag mi bya/ /bla ma'i rgan rabs phyag 'tshal lo/ /rtag par rgyun du sngags bzla zhing / /bsam gtan nyid kyang rnam par spyad/ /rtag tu slob ma bsdu bya zhing / /rtag par ru ni bshad par gyis/ /rtag tu sems can bskyang bar bya/ /rtag tu sangs rgyas cher mnyes bya/ /dzambha la la chu byin zhing / /las rnams thams cad yang dag spyad/ /bye ma'i las la mchod rten yang / /mkhas pas cho ga bzhin du bya/ /zhes gsungs te/ de dag gi don ni 'di yin te/ spang bya spong ba'i dbang du byas nas rtsa ba'i ltung ba bcu bzhi dang yan lag gi ltung pa brgyad/ bsten bya bsten pa'i dbang du byas nas las dang po pa'i bsgrub pa'i chos bcu bdun dang / brtan pa cung zad thob pas bsgrub pa'i bslab bya rnam pa lnga dang / de'i shugs kyis brtan pa cher thob nas/ dam tshig sdom las rnam par grol/ /zhes pa'i tshul gyis blang dor med par spyad dgos pa rnams bstan pas na/ de dag ngo shes par byas nas spang blang tshul bzhin du ma brjed par bya dgos so/ /gnyis pa 'bras bu'i dbugs dbyung ba ni/

'dod chags bral ba lta bu yi/ /khams gsum na ni sdig med de/ /de bas 'dod la chags bral bar/ /khyod kyis nam yang mi bya'o/ /ma hā sa ma ya ha na hūm̐ phaṭ/ zhes pa ste/ de'i don ni 'di yin te/ dad pa chen pos lha dang bla ma la chags pa/ snying rje chen pos sems can gyi don la chags pa/ shes rab chen pos chos kyi de kho na nyid kyi don la chags pa/ bde ba chen pos byang chub kyi sems la chags pa 'di bzhi dang bral ba las sdig che ba med pas 'di bzhi dang ma bral bar bya'o/ /de nas khyed rang rnams dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo nas lus thams cad sa la phab ste phyag byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ khyed rnams sngags dang rgyud 'dzin pa'i slob ma yin pas slob dpon gyis dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs la phul ba'i mos pa mdzad nas dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs la dbu dud pa re mdzod/ rdo rje lag tu bzung nas/ sngags dang rgyud rnams 'dzin gyur pa'i/ /slob ma 'di ni 'bul ba lags/ /zhes lag pas 'bul ba'i stangs ka tsam bya/ dkyil 'khor ba rnams kyis spro ba bskyed cing 'bras bu'i dbugs dbyung bar mos pa mdzod/ sngags dang rgyud rnams 'dzin gyur par/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /lha rnams kun gyis mthun par gsungs/ /sems can rnams la rjes brtse bas/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin du bris/ /khyod kyis nan tan bskyed nas su/ /sgrub pa po rnams sngags la sbyor/ /de ltar byas na sangs rgyas la/ /phan 'dogs drin du bzo zhes bya/ /khams gsum gyi ni rgyal srid che/ /dpal ldan yon tan 'byung ba'i gnas/ /bdud tshogs kun las nges rgyal te/ /grong khyer mchog tu zhugs pa yin/ /zhes gsungs te/ de'i don ni khyed rnams sngags dang / rgyud dang / man ngag 'dzin pa'i rdo rje slob dpon chen po sangs rgyas byang sems dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu gsungs pas/ deng phyin chad snying rje chen po'i sgo nas rdo rje slob dpon gyi las su bya ba sems can gyi don rgya chen po gyis shig

de ltar na phyag rgya bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ sems kyi dri ma dag dam tshig bud med la mi smad pa la dbang / brda' byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya/ lam dkyil 'khor bsgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu chos kyi sku'i bag chags dang sa bon ma lus pa rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ /zhes rtogs pa bskyed pa rnams kyis shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba song nas/ bla ma sku gsung thugs ngo bo nyid kyi sku'i bdag nyid can la tshig dbang rin po che bzhi pa zhu ba'i yon du dmigs te maṇḍal zhig 'bul bar zhu/ de ltar maṇḍal phul nas gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gyi bar du mdzod/ mgon po thugs rje che ldan pa/ /dbang bskur gsum po bdag la gnang / /rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pa/ /bzhi pa yang ni byin gyis rlobs/ /de ltar gsol ba btab nas khyed rang rnams don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba'i brdar oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing mig ras rnams 'ching bar zhu/ de ltar na dbang bzhi pa la tshig gi bzhi pa/ don gyi bzhi pa/ bzhi pa rten can/ lam du byed pa'i bzhi pa/ 'bras bu'i bzhi pa ste lngar yod pa las/ 'di tshig gi bzhi pa yin/ de'ang dbang gsum pa'i dus kyi ye shes de nyid dbang bzhi pa'i tshig gi sgo nas ngo sprod pa yin te/ /rtsa rgyud brtag gnyis las/ ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing / /rdo rje nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu/ /rdul bral mthar phyin zhi ba nyid/ /khyed rang yang ni de yi pha/ /zhes gsungs te/ de'i don ni dbang gsum pa'i dus su phyag rgya dang mnyam par sbyar ba las byung ba'i bde chen lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes 'di ni/ dpe dang gtan tshigs la sogs pa gang gi sgo nas kyang rtogs par dka' bas ches phra/ mtshan ma dang rnam par rtogs pa gang gis kyang tshur brdzi bar mi nus shing / phar thams cad 'dzom par byed pas na rdo rje/ mtha' dbus dang bral ba nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu/

nyon mongs pa'i sdug bsngal dang bral bas na rdul bral/ mthar srid pa thams cad zad pa rdo rje 'chang gyi go 'phang thob par byed pas na mthar phyin/ gdod ma nas ma skyes pas zhi ba/ khyed rang yang ni de yi pha/ /zhes pa ni/ de lta bu'i ye shes de nyid thabs gzhan la ma ltos par bla ma'i byin rlabs dang / phyag rgya'i rten 'brel la brten nas rang gi rgyud la rang gis ye shes bskyed par bya dgos te/ 'jig rten na rang gi rigs rang gis spel dgos pa ltar/ rang rgyud la ye shes bskyed pa yang rang gi bsgom pa la rag las pa yin pas de'i don nyams su blang ba'i ched du khyed rang rnams sems ma yengs par rkang pa skyil krung / lag pa mnyam gzhag sgal tshigs drang por bsrang ba la sogs pa bsam gtan gyi yan lag chos bdun dang ldan par byas/ ngag rlung rgyu ba sor bzhag yid kyis sngar dbang gsum pa'i dus su phyag rgya dang mnyam par sbyar ba las byung ba'i ye shes 'dis mtshon nas/ brtan g.yo snod bcud 'khor 'das kyi bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang gi sems las logs su gyur pa cung zad tsam yang med pas sems de nyid kyi mtshan nyid gsal ba/ rang bzhin stong pa/ ngo bo zung 'jug gsum dbyer mi phyed par spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba nam mkha' lta bu ste/ de'ang nam nam mkha' la thog mtha' med pa bzhin du sems la yang thog mtha' med/ nam mkha' la mtha' dbus med pa bzhin sems la yang mtha' dbus med/ nam mkha' la 'dus byas kyi gnod pas mi brdzi ba bzhin du/ sems kyang blo bur gyis rkyen gang gis kyang mi 'jig khyab tshul gyi dbang du byas na nam mkhas 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad la khyab pa bzhin du sems kyis kyang khyab/ grub tshul gyi dbang du byas na gang du'ang ma grub /nam mkha' la dbyibs dang / kha dog thams cad dang bral ba bzhin/ sems yang bzung 'dzin la sogs pa rnam par rtog pa thams cad dang bral bas stong pa nyid de/

dang por skye ba rgyu'i stong pa/ bar du gnas pa rang gi ngo bos stong pa/ mthar 'gag pa 'bras bu'i stong pa ste skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba'i stong pa nyid yin la/ de yang stong pa nyid yin no zhes ci yang med par ri bong gi rwa dang nam mkha'i padmo lta bu ma yin par gsal ba dang ma bral ba/ bde ba dang ma bral ba ste dbang gsum pa'i gnas skabs su khyed rang rnams lha sku zhal phyag gi rnam pa yab yum zhal sbyor gyi tshul du gsal la ma 'gags pa sgyu ma lta bu'i sku can du snang ba sprul pa'i sku dang / de'i sems rgyud 'dzag med kyi bde bas gang ba longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang / de'i ngo bo stong pa nyid spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba chos kyi sku dang / de gnyis dbyer mi phyed pa ngo bo nyid kyi sku ste/ de'ang gsal ba'i dus na stong pa/ stong pa'i dus na gsal ba ste gsal stong zung 'jug gam/ bde stong gi ngang la 'dzin med du khong lhod kyis slod de cung zad cig mnyam par 'jog par zhu/ de dbang gi dngos gzhi yin/ dbang de thob pa'i brdar oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing gdong ras rnams 'grol bar zhu/ de'i mtha' brten du gzengs bstod pa ni/ mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /btsud pa dang ni mthong ba yis/ /de ring sdig las rnam grol 'gyur/ /de ring khyed rnams bde bar gnas/ /bde chen theg pa 'di la ni/ /phyin chad 'chi ba yod ma yin/ /mi thub pa dang mi 'chi bas/ /cis kyang mi 'jigs dga' bar gyis/ /srid pa shin tu dag pas na/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las bton/ /de'i don ni mchog tu gsang ba dam pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir khyed rnams zhugs shing mthong ba la brten nas sdig pa dang sdug bsngal thams cad las grol te/ bde ba chen po sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par byed pas na lam 'di la dga' ba dang spro ba khyad par can bskyed par gyis shig de ltar na don dam pa byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du tshig dbang rin po che bzhi pa thob/

lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag dam tshig dgongs te gsungs ba'i dam tshig bsrung ba la dbang / brda' mdzub mos nam mkha' mtshon pa/ lam rdo rje'i rba rlabs bsgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu ngo bo nyid kyi sku'i bag chags dang sa bon ma lus pa rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ /de rnams kyis dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs par thob pa yin pas de dag gi gnas skabs su khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa la bsrung sdom tshul bzhin du bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gyi bar du mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi/ /de rnams kyis dbang yongs su rdzogs par thob pa'i gtang rag tu dmigs te maṇḍal zhig 'bul bar zhu/ de ltar maṇḍal phul nas lus longs spyod la sogs pa rnams yon du dbul zhing cha shas kyi sgo nas longs spyad du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gyi bar du mdzod/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du/ /khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags na/ /khyed kyi slob mar bzung ba dang / /cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol/ /de rnams kyi sgo nas rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po bir wa pas bkral zhing / rdo rje 'chang gnyis pa dpal sa skya pa yab sras rnams kyi thugs nyams su bzhes pa'i rje btsun bdag med ma lha mo bco lnga'i dkyil 'khor chen por dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs par thob pa yin pas dam tshig dang sdom pa la bsrung sdom sogs tshul bzhin bgyi ba'i sgo nas rang gzhan gyi don rgya che bar mdzod/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs brjod cing slob ma rnams rang gnas su btang / de ltar bdag med ma dpal gyis/ /smin byed dbang gi mtshams sbyor gang / /'phrin las rab rgyas zhes bya 'di/ /mkhyen rab dbang po sku mched dang / /khyab bdag mus pa chen po yi/ /zhabs sen spyi bo'i rgyan bkod pa'i/ /shākya'i dge bsnyen sa skya pa/ /theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa/

/ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis/ /bsam pa rnam par dag pas sbyar/ /'di las bsod nams gang thob des/ /bdag dang gdul byar bcas pa rnams/ /dus 'dir tshe ring nad med cing / /bsam don kun 'grub bstan pa rgyas/ /'gro kun smin grol lam bkod de/ /phyi ma bde ba can 'gro shog/ //sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma lha mo bco lnga'i smin byed dbang gi mtshams sbyor 'phrin las rab rgyas/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
